jobs.title: Project Manager - Utility Solar Midwest
jobs.description:
Your Job

DEPCOM Power, a Koch company and a leading renewable energy Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) firm, is seeking a Project Manager
to lead the delivery of large‑scale utility solar, battery energy storage (BESS), and repowering projects in the Midwest portfolio. In this role, you will have full responsibility for project execution from pre‑construction planning through commissioning and closeout while balancing safety, cost, schedule, quality, and stakeholder expectations.

This role is ideal for a proven project leader who thrives in fast‑paced construction environments and brings experience managing complex EPC or large‑scale infrastructure projects.

This is a remote position
with approximately 50% travel
to active construction sites based on project needs.

Our Team

DEPCOM’s Project Delivery Organization specializes in executing comprehensive, turnkey PV and BESS projects, complete with collection substations and generation transmission lines. We leverage strategic partnerships with key vendors and subcontractors, ensuring seamless coordination with interconnection utilities nationwide. As a proud member of Koch Industries, we are committed to driving innovation and maintaining the highest standards through Principle Based Management. This approach not only streamlines our processes for client success but also empowers our supervisors to cultivate an environment where employees can fully realize their potential and excel in their roles.

What You Will Do

Lead, coach, and support a multidisciplinary team including, Project Engineers and Construction Management, to drive successful execution of utility-scale and battery storage projects.
Manage project forecasts with the support of the Project Controls team to drive an accurate forecast complete with identification of risks and opportunities.
Work closely with Supply Chain to maximize value during the buyout phase of a project.
Work closely with Business Development and the Estimating team to deliver accurate and competitive Project Estimates.
Manage a project schedule with support of the Scheduling team to meet or improve project objectives.
Provide timely project reporting to internal teams and external customers.
Ensure project is in compliance with regulatory and contractual requirements with support of internal resources.
Build rapport with customers and find strategic opportunities to drive long-term mutually beneficial relationships.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

Supervisory/leadership experience
Experience managing EPC, large-scale industrial, or large-scale infrastructure projects
Experience with cost estimating, scheduling, and customer engagement
Understanding of prime contract and subcontract language
Legal authorization to work permanently in the United States for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship now or in the future
Valid driver’s license

What Will Put You Ahead

EPC experience in Utility Solar, Wind, BESS, conventional power or industrial projects
Strong construction execution experience

For this role, we anticipate paying $150k - $225k per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.

Who We Are

As a Koch Engineered Solutions company, DEPCOM Power is a leading energy solutions partner for the utility solar and broader energy industries, providing project development support, engineering, procurement and construction, energy storage, repowering and operations and maintenance services. Our highly skilled team of conventional and renewable power industry experts work to deliver the lowest cost of energy and the highest rate of return.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Equal Opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. jobs.title: Senior Biospecimen Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

LabConnect improves lives by partnering with pharmaceutical and biotech companies, and clinical research organizations (CROs) to accelerate the development of new medicines around the world.

We are an independent, global, one-stop-shop focused on delivering Central Laboratory Services that are tailor-made, timely and flexible to meet the evolving study demands of traditional to increasingly complex trials. Additionally, we provide Functional Service Provider (FSP) Solutions, supporting our clients with scientific and technical expertise, acting as an extension of their team, coordinating all laboratory related needs, advising on strategies for lab data collection and providing end-to-end analytical and logistical solutions.

The Senior Biospecimen Project Manager will be the centralized point of contact to drive biospecimen lifecycle management and resulting analytical data from clinical studies.

Please note: This is a remote role is open to candidates based in the United States. Candidates located in California are eligible only if they reside outside of the San Francisco Bay Area (defined as locations more than 100 miles from the Bay Area).

Responsibilities:

Drive biospecimen lifecycle management from sample receipt to analysis and final disposition
Ensure accurate specimen metadata
Communicate study specimen updates to client groups and stakeholders
Increase the efficiency of specimen management through sharing of knowledge and best practices
Provide site support and drive query resolution
Participate or lead special projects as assigned
Adhere to client policies and Standard Operating Procedures
Review clinical study protocols and service providers’ scope of work documents for sample handling and processing details
Set up and maintain a complex study sample tracker – experience in manual sample tracking for complex clinical studies
Create and manage project plans
Manage data transfer plans with analytical laboratories
Manage data received from external and internal laboratories, including data generated in exploratory studies
Manage specimen metadata discrepancies and ensure resolution
Submit specimens for analytical assays per study timelines
Review status of specimens collected and completeness of data
Contribute to meeting database locks by ensuring all specimens have a final result and data transfer is complete; create reports for data management as needed
Provide guidance to others and act as technical resource within the department
Lead projections for annual and long-term planning to clinical team
Provide oversight and management to junior personnel

Skills/Abilities:

Understanding of transaction-based inventory and data management systems as well as clinical trial processes
Understanding of ICH, GCP, GLP, and local regulations
LabMatrix experience preferred
Strong excel experience required, extensive macro and template building knowledge desired
Strong computer literacy, including Word, SharePoint, Smartsheet and PowerPointAdvanced planning, organizational, time management skills

Experience / Education:

B.A./B.S. in life sciences, medical technology, or related field and 5-7 years of directly related experience.
Experience in life sciences or medically related fields, including clinical development, biospecimen lifecycle management, or clinical laboratory analysis.
Project Management experience is also preferred.
Very high attention to detail and excellent multi-tasking skills is required for success in this position.

Join our team and discover how your work can impact patients' lives
around the world!

Some of the Perks our LabConnectors Love:

Financial Security (Base Pay, 401k Match and Possible Annual Bonus Eligibility)
Health Benefits beginning on date of hire
PTO plan, plus 11 Paid Company Holidays, and 1 Day to Volunteer in your community
Short and Long-Term Disability, Life Insurance, and AD&D
We celebrate our differences, which enriches our culture!

In addition to great perks and challenging work assignments, we invest in our people with career growth opportunities, globally. We believe in a friendly and collaborative environment with open lines of communication. While living out our values of People First, Quality Focused, Customer Centered, Technology Driven,
and Accountability Always
.

We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and value the diversity of our workforce. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. To learn more about equal employment opportunity, please view the posters here: https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/posters

LabConnect also prioritizes the privacy and security of your personal data. All candidate information is handled in accordance with General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). To learn more, please review our Privacy Notice on our website, by navigating to https://www.labconnect.com/

If you need assistance to complete your job application, search for a job opening, or submit an online application at LabConnect, please email talent@labconnect.com or call +1 (423) 722-3155.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Clinical Study Manager - Clinical Trial Manager II

At ICON Strategic Solutions, you will work in a sponsor-dedicated model, supported by ICON’s global expertise.

As the world’s largest FSP organisation, with over 90 sponsor partnerships, we offer stability, career development and a collaborative environment where your work contributes to the development of treatments that benefit patients worldwide.

As a Senior Project Manager at ICON, you will be responsible for leading and manage projects, ensuring successful execution and delivery of project objectives.

What You Will Do

You will manage day-to-day project and programme management activities, supporting your team to deliver quality outcomes.

Key Responsibilities Include

Developing and executing project plans, focusing on achieving project goals and objectives.
Leading cross-functional teams to ensure the successful implementation of project activities.
Collaborating with stakeholders to identify project requirements and define project scope.
Mentoring and guiding team members, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.
Driving the development of project documentation and reports to present findings to stakeholders in a clear and actionable manner.
Staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies to integrate best practices into project management strategies.
Contributing to organizational growth through effective project leadership and strategic planning.

Your Profile

You will have solid project and programme management experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities and develop your team.

Required Qualifications And Experience

Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific discipline or healthcare-related field
Extensive experience in project management, with a proven track record of leading successful projects in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.
Strong proficiency in project management tools and methodologies, with excellent attention to detail.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop effective project strategies.
Demonstrated leadership skills, with experience in managing and mentoring teams effectively.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to diverse audiences.
Detail-oriented, with strong organizational skills to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
Willingness to travel as required (approximately 25%)

What ICON Can Offer You

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

Our Benefits Examples Include

Various annual leave entitlements
A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs.
Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being.
Life assurance
Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

At ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know or submit a request here

Interested in the role, but unsure if you meet all of the requirements? We would encourage you to apply regardless – there’s every chance you’re exactly what we’re looking for here at ICON whether it is for this or other roles.

jobs.description:
Job Requirements

Project Manager

At Fearless, we are seeking a Project Manager to lead a large-scale modernization of a public-facing government website and its supporting content management and publishing processes. This initiative will deliver a modern Drupal-based digital experience that improves accessibility, usability, findability, content governance, and long-term maintainability. The Project Manager will lead delivery across requirements refinement, solution design,

implementation, testing, and content migration while coordinating a multidisciplinary team spanning engineering, UX/design, content strategy, accessibility, cloud infrastructure, migration, and quality assurance. This role will serve as a primary partner to government stakeholders and agency IT teams, ensuring work remains aligned to project goals, risks and dependencies are actively managed, decisions and approvals are driven to resolution, and customer feedback is incorporated throughout iterative delivery. This is a fully remote role.

As a Project Manager, you manage and integrate multiple projects to deliver a single, impactful outcome. You operate independently, providing world-class service that drives account growth and ensures positive net customer retention across all assigned project offices. This role involves overseeing project delivery and leading and mentoring team members, equipping them with the skills necessary to be effective in their roles. You will foster collaboration and excellence, ensuring successful project outcomes while contributing to the organization's strategic growth.

Fearless Your Responsibilities In This Role:

Lead overall project delivery across requirements, architecture and design, implementation, and migration phases.
Serve as the primary coordination point between the delivery team, government stakeholders, and agency IT partners.
Plan and facilitate stakeholder workshops, requirements sessions, planning meetings, design reviews, and demonstrations.
Manage project scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, decisions, and deliverable approvals.
Coordinate work across technical, design, content, accessibility, and migration team members to ensure alignment and progress.
Maintain visibility into progress and surface issues or decisions requiring customer input quickly and clearly.
Manage iterative Agile delivery and ensure customer feedback is incorporated throughout the project lifecycle.
Coordinate deliverable reviews, acceptance, and phase transitions with government stakeholders.
Support documentation, knowledge transfer, operational transition, and project closeout activities.

Customer & Fearless Impact:

The Impact You Will Create in this Role:

A Successful Candidate In This Role Can Independently Operate With Little To No Support From Their Leadership In Day-to-day Tasks And Decision-making. This Team Member Will Also Proactively Understand The Implications Of Their Decision-making And Be Able To Convey It Through Their Project Strategy And Day-to-day Influence. This Project Manager Will Impact Fearless’ Customers By:

Effectively managing and integrating multiple projects, you will deliver impactful outcomes that drive customer satisfaction and account growth. Y
Enhancing team performance, ensuring that each project is executed to the highest standard.
Contributing to positive net customer retention, reinforcing the organization’s reputation for excellence in the account industry, project assigned.
Ensure that Fearless positively impacts our customers' missions and the lives of the people they serve by consistently delivering world-class products and services on time and within budget.

Work Experience

Project Skill and Experience Requirements

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
Minimum of 7 years of total relevant professional experience.
At least 3 years of experience leading enterprise-wide website modernization or digital transformation initiatives, with that experience occurring within the past 5 years.
Experience supporting at least one government, higher education, or similarly regulated organization project.
Experience delivering at least one Drupal solution hosted on AWS.
Experience leading complex enterprise website modernization, CMS modernization, or digital transformation initiatives through requirements, design, implementation, testing, migration, and production transition.
Demonstrated experience leading Agile delivery, including iterative planning, backlog and dependency coordination, stakeholder reviews, demonstrations, and incorporation of customer feedback.
Experience leading cross-functional teams spanning software engineering, architecture, UX/design, content strategy, accessibility, DevOps/cloud infrastructure, QA, and content/data migration.
Experience planning and facilitating stakeholder workshops, requirements-refinement sessions, planning meetings, design or solution reviews, demonstrations, and decision-making sessions.
Demonstrated experience managing project scope, schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and changes across complex multidisciplinary initiatives.
Experience establishing and maintaining clear project governance, including decision-making processes, escalation paths, stakeholder responsibilities, and visibility into project health.
Experience coordinating customer reviews and managing deliverables through acceptance criteria, review cycles, approvals, and formal sign-off.
Experience translating business and stakeholder needs into actionable delivery plans and coordinating teams through requirements refinement and implementation.
Experience identifying and managing cross-team dependencies and proactively surfacing risks, blockers, decisions, and customer actions that could affect delivery.
Experience coordinating major implementation milestones, including testing, UAT, migration/cutover activities, production readiness, and transition to operations.
Experience managing project documentation, status reporting, decision tracking, knowledge transfer, and operational transition activities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, content owners, agency leadership, and IT partners.

Preferred Experience

Experience leading Drupal modernization programs or large-scale CMS implementations.
Experience delivering AWS or other cloud-hosted solutions within government or regulated environments.
Experience leading large-scale website content and data migrations involving thousands of webpages, documents, media assets, and redirects.
Experience delivering accessibility-focused digital projects incorporating WCAG 2.1/2.2 requirements throughout design, development, testing, and release.
Experience leading public-sector digital transformation or government website modernization initiatives.
Experience coordinating content governance, publishing workflow, or organizational process transformation as part of a website modernization.
Experience working with formal customer deliverables, acceptance processes, and phase-based approvals.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Remote) - Data Center Construction Projects
jobs.description:
Are you a collaborative professional with experience delivering mission-critical data center design and construction projects? Otak CPM (Comprehensive Project Management) is hiring a remote Project Manager to join our growing team. This role requires at least 3 years of experience working in data center construction environments, along with experience serving as an Owner’s Representative. This opportunity is ideal for a high-achieving self-starter who is ready to take on new responsibilities, contribute to complex projects, and grow their career within a dynamic, forward-thinking organization.

The Project Manager role requires leaders who excel at managing people, processes, and complex projects. Ideal candidates have a proven track record of building strong, productive partnerships through effective relationship-building, sound industry knowledge, and consistent delivery of successful project outcomes in design and construction environments. As the primary client contact for a diverse portfolio of work, you will lead multiple projects across the United States. This role involves navigating complex design and planning efforts, engaging a broad range of stakeholders, and collaborating with architects, engineers, contractors, and other project partners to gather input, solve problems, and guide projects through key milestones on behalf of our clients.

This position offers significant opportunities for professional growth as our work continues to expand.

How You'll Contribute

Lead multiple concurrent datacenter construction projects of varying size, complexity, and phase, from early planning through completion.
Oversee the delivery of greenfield, brownfield, and retrofit engineering and design projects through all phases, including site due diligence, land development, detailed design, permitting, construction administration, and turnover to Operations.
Manage internal and external resources to support building, power, cooling, telecom, and controls scope in alignment with client capacity roadmaps.
Coordinate internal client stakeholders and external consultants, including architects, engineers, contractors, and specialty vendors.
Facilitate problem-solving and support the incorporation of new equipment and operational processes.
Provide design and construction coordination for datacenter projects, guiding key decisions and maintaining alignment with client goals.
Oversee datacenter design and construction work across the Americas, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and quality.
Build strong, productive relationships with clients and project partners while providing subject matter insight and ensuring successful project delivery.
Collaborate and cross-train with Otak team members to improve efficiency, quality, and project delivery.

The Strengths You Bring

Engineering Degree in: Architecture, Civil, Structural, Mechanical, or Construction disciplines.
7+ years of progressively responsible experience in construction or design-related fields, including 3+ years in data center construction environments and experience serving as an Owner's Representative.
Professional Engineer (PE) or Registered Architect (RA) a plus.
Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical teams in a fast-paced, dynamic setting and adapt quickly to shifting priorities.
Proven ability to lead engineering teams in advanced engineering and operational processes for large datacenter and critical-facility environments, while managing personnel, budgets, schedules, and complex project portfolios.
PMP and/or CMIT certification (or active pursuit); OSHA 10 Certification.
Experience with commercial and high-tech construction, including retrofits; familiarity with all phases of design and construction management.
Demonstrated success managing multiple design projects of varying complexity and stage.
Solid understanding of regulatory requirements, land-use processes for green-field construction/site, and contractual change management.
Advanced oral and effective written communication skills and experience in meeting facilitation and a growing competency in exercise facilitation (e.g., RACI and other project management tools).
Working knowledge of AI tools, SharePoint, Smartsheet, Bluebeam, Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Project, and construction management software.
Proven experience managing projects in a virtual/remote environment, with willingness to travel as needed.

Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate experience, qualifications, and work location as well as market and business considerations.

Salary Range: $120,000 - 150,000 per year

Benefits

At our core, we believe that supporting our communities begins with supporting our employees. No matter what stage you’re at in your career, we have a comprehensive total rewards program to enhance your quality of life, help support your family, and assist you in achieving your personal and professional goals. Otak employees enjoy competitive salaries; discretionary performance bonuses; no-cost medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, HRA/HSA; a 401(k)-retirement match; Paid Time Off (PTO) accrual based on your industry experience rather than your seniority plus 9 paid holidays per year; support for your professional registration and/or certification fees; and much more!

Why work at Otak?

We’re not just looking for skills and experience, having shared values is just as important! When you work at Otak, you aren’t just joining a firm — you’re joining a community. We believe our best work happens in a culture of collaboration and inclusion, where the expertise of diverse individuals can thrive in a foundation of teamwork. The work environment we create is built on a simple concept: working on interesting projects with interesting people. However, we don’t just believe in cultivating our own community; we’re also committed to enriching the communities around us with smart, creative solutions. We know our employees make an investment in us, so we’re committed to making an investment in them. Seasoned experts and young professionals work together to encourage personal growth and skill development at all experience levels. Plus, we’re expanding — and we’re dedicated to developing an internal infrastructure with the strength and talent to support that growth.

Equal Opportunity

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role:

We are seeking a strategic and detail-oriented Time & Absence Program Manager to lead the design, implementation, and ongoing management of our global time and absence programs. This role owns the systems, policies, and processes governing time tracking, leave management, and absence administration—ensuring accuracy, compliance, and a seamless employee experience across all regions. The ideal candidate combines strong program management skills with deep expertise in time and attendance systems and global leave/absence regulations.

What You'll Do:

Program Strategy & Ownership

Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of global time and absence programs
Define program goals and success metrics for accuracy, compliance, and supportive employee experiences
Serve as the subject matter expert on time tracking, leave of absence, and absence management practices
Continuously evaluate and improve programs to enhance efficiency and employee experience

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate with HR, Benefits, and Legal on leave policy design and administration
Work with regional stakeholders to balance global standards with local requirements
Work closely with Product Manager and IT to optimize time and absence modules within Workday
Partner with Payroll to ensure accurate data flow between time/absence, payroll, and HR systems

Compliance & Governance

Ensure programs comply with global, regional, and local labor laws and leave regulations (e.g., FMLA, FLSA, statutory leave entitlements, working time directives)
Monitor regulatory changes and update policies, processes, and configurations accordingly
Translates regulatory requirements into system and program design specifications

Change Management & Enablement

Develop training and enablement materials, documentation, and communications for program implementations and enhancements
Lead change management for new system rollouts and policy updates
Provide guidance and support to HR teams, managers, and employees
Gather feedback to inform continuous improvement

Bachelor's degree in Human Resource, Business, or related field
5+ years of experience in program/project management, with 5+ years in time and absence

jobs.title: AI Program Manager - Special Projects & Innovation
jobs.description:
Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance.

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title:

AI Program Manager — Special Projects and Innovation

Position Location:

Remote — work virtually from anywhere in the United States, with occasional travel to job sites, lab environments, and company meetings

Job Summary

Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance. Our Special Projects and Innovation (SPI) group is where we pursue the ideas that do not fit inside a standard project — and it is the home of SmartTech.ai, our company-wide AI enablement program.

AI adoption at STC has grown fast and organically: capable people across every department have built real tools and returned real time. That grassroots energy is our foundation — and it has outgrown an informal, team-by-team approach. As AI Program Manager, you will take SmartTech.ai from siloed experimentation to a governed, supported, and scalable capability — setting light-touch policy and standards, standing up the development frameworks and hosting platforms that turn prototypes into deployable products, pairing the right tools to the right use cases, and raising the AI fluency of every employee through training, messaging, and hands-on support.

This is STC's first dedicated AI enablement hire. You will report to the VP of Engineering & Technology, operate within the SPI department, and coordinate a hub-and-spoke network of departmental AI Champions. You are equal parts builder and enabler — technical enough to architect and ship AI solutions yourself, and skilled enough with people and process to make the entire company better at using AI. You will receive general direction on objectives and work independently to build the program, communicating and operating in line with organizational goals and values as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Program Governance, Policy & Intake (20%)

Establish light-touch, practical governance for AI use company-wide — acceptable-use standards, data-handling and security guardrails, and a clear tool-approval pathway — in partnership with IT and InfoSec
Contribute to development of the innovation and idea intake (“funnel”), triaging incoming requests and prototypes and prioritizing them by value, effort, and risk
Maintain a lightweight review cadence that keeps the program safe and consistent without slowing the people doing the work

AI Enablement, Training & Messaging (20%)

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
The Program Manager serves as the overall manager and single point of contact (POC) for all contractor activities supporting the government on an Assessment & Authorization (A&A) task order. This individual provides strategic leadership, program oversight, and operational direction to ensure the successful execution of all contractual requirements.

The Program Manager is responsible for managing multiple projects and task orders, overseeing program risks and dependencies, integrating contractor-to-contractor efforts, and ensuring seamless coordination across all A&A workstreams and delivered services. The Program Manager maintains consistent, proactive communication with Government stakeholders and serves as the primary liaison between the customer and the contractor throughout the life of the contract.

Work Location: Preferred Location is Washington, DC Metropolitan Area. Remote Consideration: This position may be performed remotely from anywhere within the United States, based on contract requirements and customer approval. Periodic travel to customer sites, program meetings, and contractor locations may be required.

Responsibilities

Serve as the overall Program Manager and primary point of contact for all A&A activities on the task order.
Provide executive leadership and strategic oversight for all program operations, ensuring successful execution of contractual objectives.
Lead large, complex programs and direct multiple concurrent projects while ensuring alignment with customer priorities and mission objectives.
Manage program risks, interdependencies, schedules, budgets, staffing, and overall program performance.
Ensure effective integration and coordination among all A&A work units, subcontractors, and supporting contractors.
Develop and maintain strong working relationships with Government leadership and serve as the senior interface with customer stakeholders.
Lead and mentor Project Managers, technical leads, and program support personnel.
Manage geographically dispersed teams across multiple customer and contractor locations, ensuring consistent communication, collaboration, accountability, and delivery of program objectives.
Supervise and manage contract personnel supporting operations at multiple sites while fostering a high-performing, customer-focused team environment.
Analyze complex program challenges and develop innovative solutions involving financial management, scheduling, staffing, technology, methodologies, and delivery approaches.
Develop both long-range and short-range strategic plans for application selection, systems development, maintenance activities, production support, and resource planning.
Direct all aspects of project planning, execution, monitoring, and performance management.
Meet regularly with Government representatives, program stakeholders, subcontractors, and contractor personnel to review task plans, milestones, deliverables, schedules, and costs.
Prepare or oversee the development of executive-level briefings, reports, presentations, and other materials for Agency leadership, executive management, and federal oversight organizations.
Track and report the status of ongoing and upcoming projects, identifying issues, risks, and mitigation strategies.
Establish program goals, performance metrics, and implementation plans that support contract objectives.
Direct financial management activities, staffing strategies, resource allocation, and operational planning to ensure technical and contractual requirements are successfully achieved.
Apply extensive knowledge of Assessment & Authorization (A&A) processes, cybersecurity frameworks, and federal compliance requirements to support informed program decisions.
Evaluate overall program performance and recommend strategic improvements that support long-term growth, operational efficiency, and mission success.
Ensure consistent, transparent, and proactive communication with Government customers throughout program execution.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business Administration, Management, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or another scientific or technical discipline. Equivalent education and experience may be considered.
Minimum of 15 years of progressively responsible program management experience supporting large, complex federal IT or cybersecurity programs.
Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects, task orders, budgets, schedules, risks, and deliverables within a federal government environment.
Proven experience leading large, geographically dispersed teams across multiple customer and contractor locations.
Experience managing subcontractors and coordinating contractor-to-contractor integration efforts.
Strong understanding of Assessment & Authorization (A&A), Risk Management Framework (RMF), NIST security standards, and federal cybersecurity compliance requirements.
Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership, senior Government officials, technical staff, and cross-functional stakeholders.
Experience preparing executive briefings, reports, project plans, and customer presentations.
Excellent leadership, organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and interpersonal communication skills.

Desired Qualifications

Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification.
Certified Authorization Professional (CAP) certification.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Experience supporting large federal civilian agencies.
Experience managing enterprise cybersecurity, Assessment & Authorization (A&A), or Risk Management Framework (RMF) programs.
Security Clearance Requirements:
Active Top Secret (TS) security clearance or DOE Q Clearance is preferred.
Candidates who do not currently possess a Top Secret or DOE Q Clearance must be eligible to obtain and maintain a DOE Q Clearance.
Ability to successfully complete all required background investigations and satisfy customer security requirements as a condition of employment.

This position is contingent upon contract award and funding. Applicants selected may be offered the position; however, they cannot begin work until the contract has been awarded and funding has been confirmed.

Job ID

2026-25507

Work Type

Remote

Pay Range

$200,000 - $235,000

Benefits

Regular - The company offers a comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(k) and a range of other voluntary benefits. Paid Time Off (PTO) is offered to regular full-time and part-time employees.

Company Description

Work Where it Matters

Akima Mission Optimization (AMO), an Akima company, is not just another federal logistics contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

At AMO, the work you do every day makes a difference in the lives of our 15,000 Iñupiat shareholders, a group of Alaska natives from one of the most remote and harshest environments in the United States.

For our shareholders
, AMO provides support and employment opportunities and contributes to the survival of a culture that has thrived above the Arctic Circle for more than 10,000 years.

For our government customers
, AMO delivers innovative administrative support services that streamline operations, and enhance productivity.

As an AMO employee
, you will be surrounded by a challenging, yet supportive work environment that is committed to innovation and diversity, two of our most important values. You will also have access to our comprehensive benefits and competitive pay in addition to growth opportunities and excellent retirement options.

Define Project Statements of Work (SOWs): Develop high-quality proposals, create value propositions, and formulate execution strategies that meet client needs and organizational goals.

Continuous Improvement

Strong leadership skills, including team building, empowering and delegating authority, and building rapport and consensus.

Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. Position Summary

The Technical Program Manager I (TPM I) is the entry point into the Technical Program Management profession at F5. This role is designed for early-career talent who demonstrate strong analytical thinking, collaboration skills, technical curiosity, and a passion for driving outcomes through influence rather than authority. The TPM I partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders to support the planning, coordination, and execution of technical initiatives.

Working under the guidance of experienced Technical Program Managers, the TPM I develops foundational program management skills while learning how to navigate technical systems, manage risks and dependencies, facilitate cross-functional alignment, and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders.

Successful TPM I employees progressively build the capabilities required to independently lead complex cross-functional programs and advance within the TPM profession.

Learn and apply TPM best practices, methodologies, tools, and frameworks across a variety of business and technology initiatives.

Saputo is looking for an IT Senior Project Manager (SAP / Business Transformation specialization)
to join our IT PMO team. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a dynamic global team in a company leveraging technology, enterprise platforms, SAP solutions, SaaS applications, and business transformation initiatives to modernize processes and create value across the organization. As a member of the Saputo PMO, you will be expected to lead through influence, bring teams together, and drive the successful delivery of strategic technology initiatives. You will plan, manage, and deliver large-scale, complex IT projects and business transformation programs, including but not limited to SAP implementations, SaaS deployments, digital initiatives, process optimization, and enterprise application modernization.. Your ability to communicate with and collaborate across IT and business stakeholders at all levels will be key to your success.

Your recipe for delivering successful projects in a dynamic and fast-paced environment includes being versatile and maintaining strong relationships with IT leaders, the business, and project core teams.

As a Project Manager, you will:

Define and lead the project approach from concept through execution, including translating ambiguous business objectives into a clear delivery strategy, work breakdown structure, staffing model, deliverables, and integrated project plan. You are responsible for establishing scope, estimates, schedule, costs, assumptions, and external dependencies in environments where requirements may initially be undefined or evolving.
Provide the Saputo IT Leadership Team with weekly progress reports including risks, issues, decisions as well as recommendations for adjustments as necessary. You will ensure the timely communication of relevant project information to all affected team members, including changes to the plans, team structure, commitments, and project dependencies.
Have strong leadership skills and provides guidance and support to optimize the performance of a diverse team, leads through influence indirect reports, and ensures that the project team follows all quality assurance processes, including periodic reviews and transitions.
Manage internal and external relationships and coordinates work between different teams globally.
Work effectively in a multi-site delivery model.
Lead the end‑to‑end management of third‑party vendors and system integrators, including participation in vendor selection, contract negotiation, commercial governance, and oversight of delivery performance throughout the full project lifecycle, ensuring alignment to scope, schedule, cost, and quality commitments.
Have a well-rounded Project Management knowledge base and the ability to quickly pickup and deliver projects across various applications and platforms.
You will also coach and support other IT resources assuming Project Lead roles, contribute to the development of PMO Processes, Tools and Methodology.

How you will make contributions that matter:

Reporting to the Portfolio Manager and working collaboratively with your stakeholders as well as the project, change management, and training teams, the Project Manager is responsible for:

Work Planning and Deliverable Management: You will adapt the PMO Work Planning processes and tools to the projects at hand and will maintain work plans, continuously monitoring actuals, and resolving/addressing cost and schedule variances. You will leverage the Deliverable Management process and tool to track the timely completion of all project Deliverables to the baselines.

Vendor and System Integrator Management: You will lead relationships with external vendors and system integrators, including defining statements of work, supporting contract negotiations, establishing delivery governance, managing financials and change controls, and ensuring vendor performance meets contractual and project expectations. Seek out new innovations and present new strategies to continuously improve all areas of your work and the organization

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Ditto

Ditto is redefining how data moves at the edge. Our mission is to make it seamless for developers to build resilient, real-time applications, regardless of network conditions. Whether you're in a stadium, airplane, or remote military base, Ditto's peer-to-peer sync engine ensures devices stay connected and data stays consistent, even without internet. With more than $145 million in funding and trusted by organizations like Chick-fil-A, Delta Airlines, and the U.S. military, Ditto powers mission-critical experiences across aviation, retail, travel, hospitality, defense, and more. As a globally distributed, fast-growing startup, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the wide range of perspectives needed to solve the world’s hardest connectivity problems.

Ditto's enterprise customers are building infrastructure on top of our platform. That means post-sales at Ditto is about delivery, not just adoption. As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will own the post-sale customer program for a small number of high-stakes enterprise accounts. You are the connective tissue between what customers need and what Ditto delivers.

You'll be managing complex, multi-threaded technical programs: driving implementations to production, translating customer requirements into engineering deliverables, orchestrating internal teams across engineering, product, FDE, and support, and owning the renewal outcome for every account in your portfolio. This role requires someone who can hold their own in a technical conversation with a customer's engineering team in the morning and run a renewal discussion with a VP in the afternoon.

If you've felt constrained by the shallow nature of traditional CSM work, or you want your program management skills to have meaningful commercial impact, this role is the antidote.

What You'll Own

Program Delivery

Build and maintain documented program plans for every assigned account, covering milestones, risks, dependencies, and clear ownership.
Drive customer implementations from kickoff to production, working backwards from go-live to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
Translate customer requirements into actionable engineering deliverables in partnership with Product, Engineering, and FDEs.
Manage parallel work streams across multiple accounts without losing track of what is at risk.

Cross-Functional Orchestration

Partner with the AE as a peer, not a support function, proactively keeping them informed of account health, customer sentiment, and any signals that have commercial implications.
Coordinate across engineering, product, support, and FDE to move customer programs forward without direct authority over any of them.
Own incident and escalation management end-to-end: route clearly, communicate accurately to the customer, and close the loop.
Be the single point of accountability for your accounts internally. If something is falling through the cracks, you catch it.

Commercial and Relationship Ownership

Own renewal outcomes for your portfolio. Renewals should never be a surprise.
Align with the AE on a shared account narrative. Customers should never experience a gap between what sales told them and what post-sales is executing against.
Surface expansion signals and route them to the AE with the context needed to act.
Establish trusted advisor status with customer engineering leads, project managers, and executive sponsors.
Conduct QBRs and executive business reviews that reflect real program status, not just a health score.

Internal Contribution

Help refine the playbook. Ditto's enterprise engagement model is actively evolving and this role will contribute to it.
Contribute structured account intelligence back to product and engineering through the voice of your customers.

Required

What We're Looking For

Demonstrated experience managing complex technical implementations with direct customer-facing accountability
Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer requirements into specific, actionable engineering deliverables
Experience and comfort owning commercial renewals and retention outcomes without carrying a formal quota
Comfort operating in fast-moving, under-defined environments
Strong written and verbal communication with both technical audiences (engineering leads, developers) and executive audiences (VP, C-suite)
Experience coordinating across internal teams including engineering, product, and support without direct authority

Strongly Preferred

Background in technical program management, professional services, or implementation in a platform/infrastructure SaaS company
Exposure to SDK- or API-based products where customers build on top of the platform
Prior experience at or familiarity with companies like Palantir, Databricks, Confluent, MongoDB, Couchbase, or similar
Experience managing incident escalations with engineering dependencies
Located in Atlanta or Washington DC

The Benefits Of Building With Us

We offer competitive salaries and meaningful equity. We believe everyone on the team should have a stake in what we’re building. Benefits vary by region to make sure you're covered in the ways that matter most. In the US, that includes health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, plus a 401(k) and flexible spending accounts.

Regardless of where you live, everyone at Ditto can utilize flexible time off. And while we work remotely, our Atlanta office is always open if you ever want a place to work or meet up with teammates.

Apply Anyway

At Ditto, we know game-changers don’t always come wrapped in a “perfect” resume. Years of experience? Every single bullet point checked? Meh. That’s not what drives us.

What does matter?

Grit.
Curiosity.
Adaptability.
And a genuine spark for what we’re building.

So if you’re fired up about our mission but not sure you tick every box - hit that apply button anyway. Use your application to show us how you’ll make an impact here.

We’re always on the lookout for exceptional humans who want to grow, stretch, and build something meaningful with us.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Ditto is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Ditto is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let us know.

Lead the end‑to‑end management of third‑party vendors and system integrators, including participation in vendor selection, contract negotiation, commercial governance, and oversight of delivery performance throughout the full project lifecycle, ensuring alignment to scope, schedule, cost, and quality commitments.
Have a well-rounded Project Management knowledge base and the ability to quickly pickup and deliver projects across various applications and platforms.
You will also coach and support other IT resources assuming Project Lead roles, contribute to the development of PMO Processes, Tools and Methodology.

How you will make contributions that matter:

Reporting to the Portfolio Manager and working collaboratively with your stakeholders as well as the project, change management, and training teams, the Project Manager is responsible for:

Work Planning and Deliverable Management: You will adapt the PMO Work Planning processes and tools to the projects at hand and will maintain work plans, continuously monitoring actuals, and resolving/addressing cost and schedule variances. jobs.title: IT Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title

IT Program Manager

Location:

Block 23

What You'll Do

As a Program Manager, you'll lead and deliver complex, high-impact IT programs and projects that align with organizational goals. You'll work on end-to-end project management, planning, and collaboration with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and vendors. As the IT Program Manager, you'll ensure programs are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards while managing risks and driving continuous process improvement. This role also requires strong technical acumen, deep understanding of SDLC, and proven experience in managing Agile/Scrum teams and providing guidance to other IT Project Managers. The ideal candidate will also have experience in banking or financial services and a track record of driving digital transformation programs.

Manage business and IT stakeholders. Work towards development of business cases in alignment with the strategic plan through collaborative discussions with senior-level business and IT partners, shared services, and risk management. Decompose plans into programs/workstreams. May include complex multi-workstream initiatives. Develop execution approach and techniques to execute according to deﬁned timelines, while keeping in mind time and budget constraints.
Plan, execute, and deliver complex IT programs, ensuring alignment with business objectives. Define project scope, goals, deliverables, and success criteria in collaboration with stakeholders.
Manage end-to-end delivery of IT projects and programs, ensuring adherence to SDLC/PMLC standards.
Develop detailed program view, project plans, budgets, and resource plans and allocation. Identify dependencies and prioritize tasks to optimize project delivery timelines.
Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing regular updates on progress, risks, and outcomes. Facilitate effective communication and decision-making across teams and leadership.
Lead cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration and accountability.
Provide mentorship and guidance to junior project managers and team members.
Ensure project documentation is up-to-date and accessible for future reference. Optimize resource utilization to maximize project efficiency.
Identify opportunities for improving project management processes and methodologies. Provide guidance to the project managers.
Drive execution of digital transformation initiatives working with cross functional technical teams.
Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to have a fair understanding of technical designs, data flows and integrations.
Ensure alignment of project deliverables with design, architecture and technology standards.
When working with Agile teams, facilitate scrum ceremonies, partner with Scrum Masters/RTEs, and promote the culture of continuous improvement.
Partner with business stakeholders, IT leadership, and external vendors to ensure alignment and management of cross functional dependencies.
Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks; maintain compliance with governance frameworks.
Prepare and present risk reports and escalation plans to leadership.
Communicate effectively with senior executives and cross-functional teams.
Influence decision-making and drive consensus across diverse stakeholder groups.
Provide regular status reporting to all stakeholders, ensuring alignment across the board.

What You'll Need

10+ years of related experience in Project Management or similar field.
Bachelor's degree in related field required. Masters or MBA in related field preferred.
Previous leadership experience preferred.
Advanced to expert experience in various PMO functions including Governance, Resource Capacity Management, Talent Development, and Program Management.
Advanced experience in IT project management managing large, complex projects with a proven track record of delivering projects on time, within budget, and to quality standards.
Advanced to expert experience with IT Program Management.
Advanced to expert relationship management skills.
Advanced to expert experience collaborating with executives, stakeholders, and management.
Advanced to expert experience leading through challenges and gaining buy-in across multiple customers/stakeholders involved in delivering program solutions.
Advanced to expert financial industry experience preferred.
Advanced speaking and writing communication skills.
Advanced experience working with project management tools (e.g., Workfront, MS Project, Planview, Jira, Azure DevOps or similar).
Strong understanding of IT systems, software development life cycles (SDLC), and cloud technologies while also demonstrating strong organizational and interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships with team members, stakeholders, and external partners.
Preferred experience with digital transformation, digital conversion or projects emerged from M&A activities.
Project Management Professional Certification, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification.
Occasional travel required.

Benefits You’ll Love

We offer all the important things you'd want — like competitive salaries, an ownership stake in the company, medical and dental insurance, time off, a great 401k matching program, tuition assistance program, an employee volunteer program, and a wellness program. In addition, you’ll have the opportunity to bolster your business knowledge, learning the ins and outs of how successful companies operate and manage their finances, giving you invaluable hands-on experience to help grow your career!

Western Alliance Bank, Member FDIC, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Western Alliance Bancorporation. Serving clients nationwide, Western Alliance Bank includes six legacy bank brands — Alliance Association Bank, Alliance Bank of Arizona, Bank of Nevada, Bridge Bank, First Independent Bank and Torrey Pines Bank — that remain part of the company’s heritage, as well as AmeriHome Mortgage, a Western Alliance Bank Company.

We will only respond to inquiries concerning requests that involve a reasonable accommodation in the application process.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Project Manager
jobs.description:
If you are currently employed at Smithfield, please log into Workday and submit your application through the Jobs Hub.

Have a seat at our table. When you join Smithfield, you become part of something special – a company that's sustainably feeding people around the world, producing good food the right way with respect for our people, animals, communities and planet. With opportunities across locations and functions, a culture grounded in our Core Four values - gratitude, communication, respect and accountability - and a strong commitment to learning, collaboration, and innovation, Smithfield offers challenging and rewarding careers where you can grow, contribute and make a real impact. Apply Now!

Your Opportunity

As part of our Engineering team, you would analyze data, draft implementation plans for production process optimization. Seeking out ways to maximize efficiencies by eliminating the waste of valuable resources that directly impact our overall operating costs. You are instrumental to the manufacturing of Smithfield, Eckrich, Nathan’s Famous, and our other product brands, to meet the needs of our customers and consumers.

The Senior Strategic Project Manager applies theories and principles of science and mathematics to design and develop technical projects for the pork and packaged meat industry. They perform engineering assignments on the most complex and large projects. They are a recognized internal expert in project management and are considered a subject matter expert, solving unique and complex problems. The role leads multiple teams on projects providing direction and coaching to ensure a successful result. The Senior Strategic Project Manager anticipates external business, vendor and regulatory issues and proactively provides broad solutions.

Core Responsibilities

Project Management
Develops and executes the overall project to ensure success through team development, multiple plans (budget, schedule, communication, risk management, etc), and necessary monitoring with corrective action.

Budget
Develops the overall budget through thorough good engineering practices to ensure an accurate cost estimate to enable the organization to make a well-informed decision.
Executes the project with pro-active budget control ensuring that each sub-team manages their budgets.

Schedule
Develops the overall schedule with good engineering practices to provide a realistic schedule.
Monitors the schedule and proactively scans the internal and external situation to ensure the project is delivered as specified.

Scope
Develops the preliminary engineering designs to meet the stated need of the project.
Monitors the scope, maintaining the original project scope preventing unnecessary scope creep while keeping the leadership actively informed of any necessary changes.

Leadership
May lead multiple teams responsible for sections of the project.
Develops and executes management routines to provide oversight and guidance to ensure each team and project section is successful.

Communication
Develops communication plans to ensure that the organization is actively engaged and always aware of the status of the project.
Pro-actively communicates potential issues with the recommended solution in advance of it becoming a problem.

Continuously improves upon robotic and controls knowledge to execute innovative solutions

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. May perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential functions.

Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited four-year college or university in Engineering or related field and 8+ years of relevant experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience, required.
2+ years of demonstrated experience in team management/development or project leadership is required.
Knowledge of engineering principles and techniques related to food processing and the meat industry, preferred.
Ability to apply sound engineering principles to operational and design issues.
Knowledge of installation and construction project scheduling.
Must possess Project Management skills; Contract Administration skills; National codes and standards interpretation skills. Previous experience in the management of multi-million dollar projects with large scopes, desirable.
Proficient in engineering economics.
Proficient in AutoCAD.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel spreadsheet software and Word processing software, other Microsoft Office products.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, organizational planning, teamwork, analytical reasoning, and adaptability.
Ability to work well with others in fast paced, dynamic environment.
Ability to be respectful, approachable and team oriented while building strong working relationships and a positive work environment.
Travel is required with extended overnight stays.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The majority of the time is spent in an office setting outside of the production plant. The plant environment will include wet or humid conditions (non-weather related), extreme cold and heat (non-weather related), working near moving mechanical parts, exposure to fumes or airborne particles, and chemicals.
Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate but can be loud when in the production area.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position may have supervisory responsibilities and lead Associate Engineers, Project Engineers, Senior Project Engineers, and Project Managers.
Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

The expected pay range for this position is $120,000 - $162,500 annually.

Smithfield Foods provides pay ranges that reflect its good faith estimate of the salary or hourly wage the company reasonably expects to pay for a position at the time of hire. Individual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, location of the position, the candidate’s qualifications and experience, internal equity, external market pay for comparable positions and budget considerations. At Smithfield Foods, base pay represents only one aspect of the comprehensive total rewards package. Learn more about our benefits package here.

Relocation Package Available Yes

EEO Information

Smithfield is an equal opportunity employer committed to workplace diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, gender identity, protected veterans status, status as a disabled individual or any other protected group status or non-job characteristic as directed by law.

If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment selection process, please call us at 757-357-1595.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated ability to align diverse engineering, hardware, QA, product, compliance, and external OEM teams.

jobs.title: Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM)
jobs.description:
Radiance Technologies is an employee-owned company with a generous benefits package that is unmatched among our peers. Employee ownership, generous 401K, full heath / dental / life / vision insurance benefits, challenging assignments, educational reimbursement, competitive salaries and work environment combine to make Radiance Technologies a great place to work and succeed.

Radiance is searching for an Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) that will be responsible for a portfolio of programs, supporting information system life cycle activities. The qualified candidate will scope information systems for new programs, prepare Risk Management Framework packages, maintain compliance throughout the system authorization period, and participate in program close-out and de-certification activities. Additionally, the candidate must maintain the day-to-day security posture through the change management and continuous monitoring process of the information system, which may include security event log analysis and end user account audits. Work hours are normal business hours, however, occasional support during non-business hours may be required.

Responsibilities

Responsible for having a strong understanding of the NIST 800-53 controls and ensure system security measures comply with applicable government policies such as the DAAG, JSIG, NIST, etc.
Oversee and implement a configuration management process that accurately assesses the impact of modifications to the information system.
Conduct and participate in vulnerability assessments and continuous monitoring activities for the information systems under their purview.
Responsible for performing incident response and business continuity activities.
Obtaining and maintaining access to authorization platforms such as eMASS, Xacta, etc. to effectively manage authorizations packages for information systems under their purview.
Prepare and maintain security authorization documentation (e.g. SOP, SSP, RAR, SCTM, POA&M)
Responsible for tracking assessment findings and developing mitigation plans.
Maintain the information assurance posture for programs the includes the periodic review of technical to ensure all applied security features are implemented and functioning as intended.
Maintains awareness of changes driven by internal and external customers and develops a security compliant plan that meets corporate needs.
Ability to manage information systems in a SCIF and SAPF environment and support remote location operations.
Responsibilities also include those outlined in the DAAG and JSIG.

Required Skills

Experience in implementing security controls of the operating systems to include Active Directory, Group Policies, and SROs.
Experience or strong working knowledge of standing up and maintaining customer networks such as SIPRNet, JWICS, etc.
Experience with various information system security compliance tools, such as Splunk, ELK, Wireshark, Snort, SCAP, SCC Tool, STIG Viewer, ACAS, Nessus, etc.
Working knowledge of information system environments to include MUSA, LAN, WAN, etc. and its information system components (i.e. switches, routers, operating systems, software, etc.)
Possess a DoD 8570.1M compliant information system certification (e.g. Security+, CISSP, CISM, etc.)

Required Experience

7+ years of experience in information systems security/information assurance implementing NISPOM Chapter 8, NIST, DAAG, ICD 503, and/or JSIG IS requirements
Experience with Risk Management Framework (RMF), Interconnected Security Agreements (ISA), Network Security Plans, and Memorandums of Understanding/Agreement (MOU/A).
Active TS/SCI clearance

Successful Candidates Will Have The Following Behavioral Competencies

Great attitude with high degree of customer focus.
Flexible and adaptable to changing priorities.
Solid problem solver.
Reliable and committed to getting the job done (including after hours as required).
Excellent coping skills and the ability to juggle multiple priorities.

We’re one of the UK’s most forward-thinking law firms, built on a foundation of innovation, collaboration, and ambition. Role: Senior Cyber and Information Security Manager
Team: IT – Technology Operations
Location: Hybrid working from Bristol, Exeter, Plymouth, or Southampton
Working Pattern: Full-time
Why this role matters: This is a pivotal opportunity to shape and lead our cyber and information security strategy, protecting our people, systems and client data whilst ensuring we remain ahead of evolving threats, regulatory requirements and client expectations.

________________________________________
What you’ll do
As our Senior Cyber and Information Security Manager, you’ll lead the continued development of our cyber and information security function within our growing national law firm.In this role, you’ll:

Define and deliver our cyber and information security strategy and roadmap.
Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on cyber risk, governance and compliance.
Own and continually enhance our Information Security Management System (ISMS).
Lead our approach to ISO 27001, NIST CSF, Cyber Essentials Plus and wider security best practice.
Oversee security operations, incident response and threat management activities.
Manage key security suppliers, partners and managed service providers.
Support client audits, due diligence requests and regulatory requirements.
Drive security awareness and embed a security-first culture across the firm.
Lead and develop a small team of Cyber and Information Security professionals.
Work collaboratively with Technology, Risk, Compliance and business teams to strengthen our security posture.

We’re looking for an experienced cyber and information security professional who combines technical expertise with strong stakeholder management and leadership skills.You’ll bring:

Significant experience in a senior cyber or information security role.
Experience within a regulated or professional services environment.
Strong knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST CSF, Cyber Essentials Plus and security governance frameworks.
Hands-on experience across risk management, incident response and security operations.
Proven ability to engage, influence and build credibility with senior stakeholders.
Experience leading, mentoring or developing security professionals.
A strong understanding of GDPR and data protection principles.
A proactive, pragmatic and solutions-focused approach.

Qualifications

Commitment to ongoing professional development.

Desirable experience

Leading ISO 27001 implementation and certification programmes.
Legal sector experience.
Managing external audits, client assurance activities and third-party security assessments.
