new_jobs.title: Implementation Manager
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Evergreen Nephrology partners with nephrologists to transform kidney care through a value-based, person-centered, holistic, and comprehensive approach to kidney care. We believe patients living with kidney disease deserve the best care. We are committed to improving patient outcomes and improving quality of life by delaying disease progression, shifting care to the home, and accelerating kidney transplants.

We help nephrologists focus on the right patients at the right time across the full care spectrum. We do this by providing them with the best-in-class interdisciplinary clinical resources, analytical insight and tools, and services to patients. We listen to the needs of our patients, our employees, and our client partners, continually working to push beyond the status quo in which the care system manages patients today.

Who You Are

You are devoted, compassionate, and enjoy being on the front lines of healthcare, changing the lives of patients by supporting them and the team by focusing on customers. You’re excited about being part of a team that is building a healthcare delivery model that ensures the highest possible quality of life and best outcomes for those in our care. You believe people living with kidney disease deserve the best person-centered, holistic, comprehensive care and want to influence the healthcare system to drive towards that. You thrive in innovative and evolving environments with high rates of change.

Your Role

As the Implementation Manager for Evergreen Connected Care (ECC), you own the day-to-day execution of practice onboarding and the ongoing operating relationships with our partner practices. Connected Care is delivered as a white-labeled extension of the practice and its providers; you are the person who makes each launch happen on time and keeps the relationship running well afterward.

You run the standard onboarding sequence at each practice - kickoff, implementation and breakout meetings, final all-hands, and the controlled outreach start - and you hold the timeline. You build and refine the meeting materials, facilitate sessions alongside the Program and Clinical Director or on your own, track every open item to closure, and make sure the right people know what is expected of them and by when.

This is an execution and coordination role. The operating model already exists; your job is to run it consistently as the program scales and keep work from falling through the cracks. This position is fully remote, with the possibility for occasional travel to on-site meetings with practices.

Role Responsibilities

Some responsibilities may vary based on the practices you support, but this role's primary duties include the following:

Practice Onboarding and Implementation
Run the ECC onboarding sequence end-to-end for each new practice, from kickoff through first outreach and the post-launch ramp review.
Hold the working timeline across multiple concurrent implementations and escalate slippage early.
Coordinate the parallel implementation and clinical workstreams so the two tracks stay in sync, including patient data intake and validation, forms and materials, outreach wording, after-hours handling, billing pathway, and system access.
Confirm and maintain the practice contact map: leadership, project champion, clinical lead, data/EHR, and billing.

Meetings and Materials
Build agendas and prepare, refine, and version the meeting materials and decks used across kickoff, breakout, and all-hands sessions.
Facilitate meetings with the Program Director or independently and drive each session to decisions and named owners.
Capture and circulate follow-ups after every meeting, and confirm the practice completes its post-meeting forms and deliverables.
Prepare recurring internal and practice-facing status updates and materials for leadership review.

Partner Practice Relationships
Serve as a primary day-to-day point of contact for partner practice leadership, administration, clinical leads, billing, and EHR/data contacts.
Manage expectations on timing, data requirements, and practice-side responsibilities, and keep communication timely and clear.
Surface practice-side risks and blockers to the Program Director before they affect launch dates or patient outreach.

Tracking, Follow-Through and Process
Maintain a single source of truth for deadlines, commitments, and open items across all practices, and drive them to closure rather than simply reporting them.
Partner with the Clinical Program Director on coordinator staffing readiness, training timing, and launch pacing.
Coordinate with internal Finance, Legal and Compliance, Data, People Operations, and Market Operations counterparts to unblock practice-facing work.
Manage vendor and platform coordination required for launch and steady state, including the technology partner's implementation and account teams.
Identify where the process breaks repeatedly and propose durable fixes - checklists, templates, trackers - so each launch is cleaner than the last.

Other duties consistent with this role, as assigned.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in implementation, program or project management, client success, or practice/provider operations, ideally in healthcare services, value-based care, or healthcare technology.
Demonstrated experience running multi-stakeholder implementations to a defined timeline with external customers or partners.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to build a clean deck and facilitate meetings of clinicians and executives.
Strong organizational discipline and follow-through; comfortable operating with autonomy and ambiguity.
Advanced skills with MS Office Suite of products including Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Willingness to travel occasionally for practice kickoffs and on-site sessions.

Able to work effectively in a primarily remote environment:
Home internet must support a minimum download speed of 25 Mbps and upload speed of 10 Mbps. Cable, Fiber, or DSL connections hardwired to the internet device are recommended
Evergreen will provide remote employees with telephony applications and equipment to meet the business requirements for their role
Employees must work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with nephrology, chronic care management, or other CMS care management programs.
Familiarity with provider practice operations, EHR data workflows, and secure patient data transfer.
Experience managing vendor or platform partner relationships.
Comfort learning care management platforms and reporting tools quickly.

Compensation

The pay range for this role is $100,000-$110,000 annually. Exact pay is determined based on experience, education, demand for the role, and other role-specific factors.

This role is also eligible for an annual bonus.

Benefits

Evergreen Nephrology’s total rewards program is designed to support you in and outside of work. You can expect:

Paid time off starting at 4 weeks for full-time employees
12 paid holidays per year
Medical, dental, vision and life insurance, including an HSA with employer match
Reimbursement for continuing medical education for eligible roles
A 401(k) program where Evergreen matches up to 4% of contributions after six months of tenure
Paid parental leave
A robust training and development program that starts with onboarding and continues throughout your career with Evergreen Nephrology

Evergreen Nephrology is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition or any other protected category under local, state or federal laws.

If you are an applicant with a disability who requires reasonable accommodation for any part of the hiring process, please contact us for assistance at recruiting@evergreennephrology.com.

new_jobs.description:
Information Security Analyst

Bank of the Orient is an independent Asian Community Bank that has proudly served the financial needs of multiple Bay Area communities for over 55 years and the Texas area. We are committed to excellence in everything we do.

We have an opening for the Information Security Analyst supports the operation, monitoring, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Bank's information security, cybersecurity risk, privacy, technology risk, and third-party risk programs. The role works across security operations, identity and access management, vulnerability management, incident response, cloud and SaaS security, data protection, business continuity/cyber resilience, security awareness, and governance, risk and compliance (GRC). The Analyst also supports the secure adoption and oversight of artificial intelligence (AI), including generative AI and large language model (LLM) technologies, and may serve as backup administrator for selected security and banking applications as needed.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

1. Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of the Bank's Information Security, Cybersecurity, Technology Risk, Privacy, GRC, Third-Party Risk Management, and Business Continuity/Cyber Resilience programs in alignment with the Bank's risk appetite, policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.
2. Monitor and analyze security events, alerts, logs, and telemetry from endpoints, servers, networks, identity platforms, cloud/SaaS services, email, and other critical systems. Triage, investigate, document, and escalate suspicious activity in accordance with established procedures and service-level expectations.
3. Support security operations technologies such as SIEM/SOAR, EDR/XDR, network security, email security, cloud security, and threat intelligence platforms; assist with alert tuning, use-case development, log-source onboarding, and operational health monitoring.
4. Perform and coordinate vulnerability and exposure management activities, including vulnerability scanning, risk-based prioritization, configuration reviews, patch/remediation tracking, penetration-test findings, security exceptions, and validation of corrective actions.
5. Participate in and coordinate cybersecurity incident response activities, including phishing/business email compromise, credential compromise, malware/ransomware, data exposure, cloud/SaaS incidents, and AI-related security events. Support evidence collection, root-cause analysis, lessons learned, tabletop exercises, and post-incident improvement actions.
6. Support identity and access management (IAM) controls, including multi-factor authentication (MFA), role-based access control (RBAC), privileged access, joiner/mover/leaver processes, periodic access certifications, service accounts, and segregation of duties for critical banking and technology systems.
7. Assist with data security and privacy controls, including information classification, encryption, data loss prevention (DLP), secure file transfer, retention, sensitive-data handling, and monitoring of non-public customer and Bank information.
8. Support security reviews for technology projects, system changes, cloud/SaaS implementations, APIs, integrations, digital banking capabilities, and new vendors. Document security requirements, identify risks/control gaps, and track remediation through implementation.
9. Support secure cloud and modern infrastructure practices, including security configuration and monitoring for Microsoft 365, Azure and/or AWS environments, SaaS applications, remote access, Zero Trust principles, endpoint/device security, and secure network connectivity.
10. Support the Bank's AI security and governance program. Perform security and risk assessments for AI/GenAI use cases and vendors; evaluate risks such as sensitive-information disclosure, prompt injection, insecure output handling, excessive agency, model/supply-chain risk, unauthorized data use, and inadequate logging or access control; and help implement appropriate guardrails, monitoring, human oversight, and acceptable-use requirements.
11. Monitor the use of approved AI-enabled tools and services, where applicable, and support controls for enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure OpenAI, ChatGPT Enterprise, AWS Bedrock, Google Gemini, or equivalent technologies. Assist with evaluation of AI-enabled cybersecurity tools for accuracy, access, data handling, and operational risk.
12. Support third-party/vendor risk management across onboarding, due diligence, contracting, ongoing monitoring, risk assessment, issue remediation, renewal, and termination. Review security documentation such as SOC reports, penetration-test summaries, business continuity information, cyber insurance, privacy practices, subcontractors/fourth parties, and AI/model-provider dependencies where relevant.
13. Collaborate with business owners, Technology, Compliance, Risk, Audit, Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure technology and vendor risks are identified, documented, accepted or remediated, and supported by appropriate controls.
14. Support cybersecurity threat intelligence and threat-informed defense activities using authoritative sources and industry information-sharing channels. Map relevant threats and incidents to recognized frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK when useful for investigation, control improvement, or reporting.
15. Conduct and coordinate security awareness activities, including phishing simulations, role-based training, emerging-threat communications, secure use of AI/GenAI, social-engineering awareness, and targeted education for employees, contractors, and third parties.
16. Maintain security policies, standards, procedures, risk registers, control evidence, issue trackers, inventories, diagrams, and other documentation. Support regulatory examinations, internal/external audits, risk assessments, and management responses.
17. Develop and analyze cybersecurity metrics, dashboards, key risk indicators (KRIs), control-performance reports, and executive-level materials to identify trends, highlight material risks, and support management decision-making.
18. Maintain current knowledge of cybersecurity threats, AI security risks, privacy and security laws, regulatory guidance, and industry practices relevant to financial institutions. Support alignment, as appropriate, with frameworks such as FFIEC guidance, GLBA, NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, CIS Controls, and OWASP guidance.
19. Serve as backup security/application administrator for selected Bank systems as assigned, including Fiserv Premier and related applications, with responsibilities focused on secure configuration, access administration, periodic access reviews, logging, and least-privilege controls. Support other operational systems (such as EZ Teller, Business Analytics, or Enterprise Output Manager) when security, access, resilience, or controlled file-transfer support is required.
20. Demonstrate quality customer service with internal and external stakeholders, actively participate in required Bank and compliance training, maintain strict confidentiality of non-public information, and comply with all applicable Bank policies, security requirements, and banking laws and regulations. Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS:

1. Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related discipline; or four (4) or more years of equivalent relevant work experience.
2. Two (2) or more years of experience in information security, cybersecurity operations, technology risk, systems/network administration, IT audit, GRC, or a related technology role is preferred. Experience in banking, financial services, or another regulated environment is strongly preferred.
3. Working knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems, TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, VPN/remote access, Active Directory/identity services, Microsoft 365, endpoint management, cloud/SaaS concepts, and common enterprise security architectures.
4. Practical experience with security monitoring, vulnerability management, incident response, IAM/access reviews, third-party risk, security awareness, or GRC activities. Experience across multiple areas is preferred; deep specialization in every area is not required.
5. Knowledge of financial-services cybersecurity and privacy expectations, including GLBA and FFIEC guidance, and working familiarity with recognized security frameworks such as NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK, and incident-response practices.
6. Working knowledge of AI/GenAI security concepts and risks, with familiarity with resources such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and OWASP guidance for LLM/GenAI applications. Direct enterprise AI security experience is preferred but not required.
7. Experience with reporting, data analysis, or query tools such as SQL, Power BI, Excel, or equivalent is preferred. Basic scripting/automation experience with PowerShell, Python, APIs, or workflow/SOAR tools is a plus.
8. Familiarity with Fiserv Premier or other core banking/application security administration is a plus.

PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS:

CompTIA Security+, CySA+, SSCP, GSEC, CISA, CISSP, GIAC certifications, Microsoft/Azure or AWS security certifications, or comparable credentials are preferred depending on experience level.

Bilingual a plus

The candidate will be subject to investigation through credit checks, reference checks, background checks and fingerprinting checks performed at the time permissible under relevant law.

Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Your Role

As a Data Analyst in our Business Intelligence organization, you will turn operational and customer data into actionable reports and dashboards that drive business decisions. You will partner directly with internal business teams, such as sales compensation, to gather reporting requirements, document technical specifications, and build user friendly data assets.

Your primary hands-on work will involve writing SQL views and building dashboards directly within Databricks using data populated by our engineering team. A key aspect of this role is context engineering, where you will add structured descriptions and metadata to tables, views, and columns so that our data is easily discoverable and accurately queried by AI tools like Claude. Additionally, you will validate report accuracy, monitor data quality, and maintain documentation of your reporting logic to ensure long-term reliability.

Your Opportunity

You will have the opportunity to build and scale the business reporting layer within Databricks.
You will be part of a globally distributed team of data professionals.
This role is designed for someone who wants to grow their analytical skills in a collaborative, business facing environment.
Leverage modern AI coding agents, such as Databricks' Genie or Claude, to assist in writing and optimizing your queries.

What You'll Need

2 to 4 years of experience in a business intelligence, reporting, or data analyst role.
Fundamental working proficiency in SQL, including an understanding of select statements, order of operations, joins, aggregations, and filtering.
Basic to working proficiency with Databrick, a comparable lakehouse, or cloud data platform such as Snowflake.
Experience building dashboards and presenting data visually using tools like Databricks native dashboards, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical business stakeholders and translate them into usable data assets.
A detail oriented mindset with comfort in documenting data objects, definitions, and logic for downstream users.

And Ideally

Prior experience writing table and column descriptions or metadata to support data catalogs, semantic layers, or natural language query tools.
Exposure to Python or PySpark within Databricks notebooks, which will give you a significant advantage for career progression on this specific team.
Familiarity with analytics engineering practices, such as dbt, or version control systems like Git.
Experience working in enterprise software, SaaS, or cybersecurity environments.

Greenstepin analytiikkatiimissä työskentelee yli 60 huippuosaajaa ja liiketoimintamme kasvaa tasaista vauhtia. Haemme nyt uutta tiimikaveria!

Greenstep on vuonna 2010 perustettu suomalainen, perheomisteinen kasvuyritys, joka tarjoaa korkealaatuisia teknologia- ja back office -palveluita asiakkaidensa kehityksen ja menestyksen tueksi. Nykyään olemme yli 800 asiantuntijan yhteisö, joka toimii Pohjoismaissa ja muualla Euroopassa. Olemme kasvaneet orgaanisesti, ja tänä päivänä Greenstepiin kuuluu tekijöitä Suomessa, Ahvenanmaalla, Ruotsissa, Norjassa, Virossa, Tanskassa ja Alankomaissa. Meillä kaikilla on yhteinen tavoite auttaa kasvuyrityksiä tulemaan johtajiksi omilla toimialoillaan.

Kasvun myötä haemme lisää tekijöitä analytiikkatiimiimme Greenstepin asiakkaiden BI-ratkaisujen kehityksen tehtäviin!

Tehtäväkuvaus

Vedät ja kehität Power BI -projekteja Greenstepin asiakkaille. Vastaat projektien kokonaisuudesta joko itsenäisesti tai isomman tiimin kanssa: ratkaisun suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta, aikataulusta ja budjetista sekä siitä, että asiakas saa raporteista oikeasti hyötyä.

Työ ei kuitenkaan rajoitu raporttien rakentamiseen. Konsulttina pääset:

Kehittämään Power BI- ja Fabric-ratkaisuja asiakkaan liiketoiminnan tarpeisiin, semanttisista malleista valmiisiin raportteihin.
Toimimaan projektipäällikkönä: pilkot kokonaisuuden, ohjaat tiimiä, pidät asiakkaan ajan tasalla ja viet projektin maaliin.
Työskentelemään advisory-roolissa: teet asiakkaille analytiikan nykytilakartoituksia, suunnittelet data-arkkitehtuuria, fasilitoit työpaljoja ja laadit kehityssuunnitelmia, joiden pohjalta asiakas tekee päätöksiä.

Pääset työskentelemään kiinnostavien asiakasyritysten kanssa, suomalaisista startupeista isompiin pörssiyrityksiin, ja apunasi toimii asiantunteva analytiikkatiimimme. Pääset myös mukaan kehittämään BI SaaS -palveluamme BI Bookia, jolla on jo satoja asiakkaita useissa eri maissa.

Olemme kasvava työyhteisö, missä uusia ideoita viedään vauhdilla eteenpäin ja jokainen greenstepiläinen pääsee kehittymään ammatillisesti. Hybridimallimme mukaisesti teemme töitä toimistoltamme käsin vähintään 50 % työajasta.

Voit lukea tästä artikkelin, jossa asiantuntijamme Antti Valtonen ja Juha Kapanen kertovat lisää analytiikkatiimistämme!

Edellytykset työssä menestymiseen

Olet kehityshaluinen ja tavoitteellinen asiantuntija. Olet tarkka työn yksityiskohdista, mutta hahmotat samalla isompia kokonaisuuksia ja osaat perustella ratkaisusi asiakkaalle. Toivomme sinulta oma-aloitteista työotetta sekä rohkeutta kokeilla uusia ratkaisuja.

Toivomme sinulta:

Vahvaa Power BI -osaamista. DAX, M ja SQL ovat sinulle tuttuja kieliä. Käytät Power Queryä ja visualisoit raportteja ammattimaisella otteella. Haluat kehittyä huippuosaajaksi hyödyntäen uusimpia työkaluja ja ominaisuuksia.
Kokemusta projektien vetämisestä. Olet vastannut aikataulusta, laajuudesta ja asiakasviestinnästä, tai olet valmis ottamaan sen vastuun.
Kykyä toimia neuvonantajana. Osaat kartoittaa asiakkaan nykytilan, tunnistaa kehityskohteet ja esittää ne selkeästi. Työpajojen vetäminen ja kehityssuunnitelmien laatiminen kiinnostavat sinua.
Kokemusta tai kiinnostusta Microsoft Fabricista ja sen komponenteista, kuten Lakehouse, Data Factory ja Dataflows Gen2.
Liiketoiminnan raportoinnin osaamista. Keskustelet raportoinnin sisällöstä yhtä luontevasti talousjohtajan kuin teknisen johtajan kanssa. Talousraportointikokemus katsotaan eduksi.
Ymmärrystä tietovarastoinnista ja data-arkkitehtuurista. SQL, Python ja muu vastaava osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.
Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta, esim. analytiikan, laskentatoimen, rahoituksen tai tietotekniikan KTM tai DI.
Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja. Viestit selkeästi ja proaktiivisesti eri sidosryhmille.
Tiimin sisäisenä työkielenä on englanti ja asiakastyöt tehdään pääsääntöisesti suomeksi.

Tiimi

Data- ja analytiikkatiimissämme työskentelee yli 60 asiantuntijaa

At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.

This position is exclusively intended for candidates who successfully completed the F5 Summer 2026 Internship Program and have received an invitation to apply for a return role.

Position Summary

This is the full-time conversion role for Data Analyst Interns who have successfully completed their internship in F5's Data Analyst Internship program and have earned their Bachelor's or Master's degree. This position marks your transition from internship to a permanent, full-time role within the F5 Digital organization, allowing you to build on the skills, relationships, and knowledge you've developed during your internship experience.

As a Data Analyst on F5's Enterprise Data Management (EDM) team within the F5 Digital organization, you will continue to support how F5 defines, improves, and validates our critical enterprise data. You'll work alongside analysts and engineers within our Data and Insights team to analyze data issues, support operational needs in current-state systems, and contribute to activities tied to data rebuild/migration efforts. This role offers you the opportunity to deepen your expertise with real-world datasets, improve data quality, and apply what you've learned about how data is managed, structured, and used to support business decisions in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

This position is based in Seattle, WA.

Eligibility & Who Should Apply

This role is exclusively available to:

Current or recent Data Analyst Interns in F5's internship program who have successfully completed their internship
Individuals who have earned or are about to earn their Bachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited college or university in the US (graduating between December 2026 and August 2027)

Your Role & Responsibilities

Building on your internship foundation, your typical day may involve:

Taking on increased ownership of EDM Data Quality operations related to customer data (Organizations/Individuals), including investigation of complex issues and conducting ad hoc analysis with greater autonomy
Contributing to the proactive quality management of customer data through profiling and analysis of third-party enrichment sources
Analyzing and validating data involved in Salesforce customer records and Marketo-related requests (as applicable), using spreadsheets, reporting tools, and basic scripting
Managing and analyzing Hardware Asset to Site/Party relationships (e.g., data supporting Renewals and Services motions), including identifying anomalies and leading cleanup efforts
Building, automating, and improving data quality dashboards/scorecards or metric summaries (e.g., Tableau and spreadsheets), focused on clarity, repeatability, and business usefulness
Leading or co-leading team meetings, status updates, and documentation; working on assigned tasks with increasing independence while continuing to collaborate across EDM stakeholders
Mentoring new interns or junior team members as you grow in the role
Following data governance, security, and privacy best practices
Performing other related duties assigned

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Understanding of basic descriptive statistics and data distributions (e.g., counts, rates, trends, outliers)
Solid understanding of data concepts (e.g., data quality, databases, schemas)
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail; ability to follow data lineage and identify root causes of data issues
Strong verbal and written communication skills (able to summarize findings for both technical and non-technical audiences)
Ability to learn quickly and comfort tackling complex, cross-system problems with curiosity and initiative
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deliver on deadlines in a collaborative environment
Proficiency with spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets) required; Tableau experience is a plus
Familiarity with SQL, Python, or R for analysis is preferred but not required
Interest in enterprise data concepts (data domains, data quality, governance, master/reference data)
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
Experience with F5's systems and business processes (gained during internship)

Requirements / Qualifications

Successfully completed a Summer 2026 internship with F5.
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, or a related technical field graduating between December 2026 and September 2027.
Must be able to start no later than September 30th, 2027.

Strong performance and positive feedback from internship managers and mentors
Willingness to remain based in or relocate to Seattle for this full-time role
Valid work authorization in the United States

Why You’ll Love F5

Seamless Transition: Move from internship to full-time with continuity in your team, projects, and growth trajectory
Professional Development: Continue developing your skills with ongoing training, mentorship, and access to advanced learning opportunities
Meaningful Work: Contribute to real business impact and solve complex enterprise data challenges

Professional development and continuous learning opportunities

Primary Purpose

These positions are located at NAS Pt. Mugu, CA and Edwards AFB, CA.

CNA is hiring for Associate Research Analysts
to join their Advanced Technology Assessment (ATA) Division. Staff at this level will provide research, analytical, and technical support on a range of projects.

As part of the Department of the Navy’s Federally Funded Research and Development Center (FFRDC), CNA’s Advanced Technology Assessments (ATA) division provides analysis that evaluates the military utility and efficacy of emerging defense technologies and prototypes, operational test and evaluation of DoD programs of record, and tactics development and resourcing decisions for existing naval aircraft.

Analyses from ATA help the Navy make data-informed resourcing, training, and modernization decisions for new and existing defense technologies, with a focus on naval aircraft. Our research supports defense innovation programs to ensure operational effectiveness and lethality and to maintain the technological superiority of US military forces. ATA also contributes independent analyses to the testing of new aviation systems and the development of tactics to optimize the effectiveness of existing aircraft.

CNA fosters an inclusive culture that values diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

At Saputo, we bring good to the table by making high-quality products, investing in our people, and supporting communities around the world . As a top 10 global dairy processor, we value contributions that matter and strive to foster an inclusive, growth-driven work environment. Ready to bring your best?

Overview of the role:

Saputo is looking for an IT Project Manager (Digital / AI specialization) to join our IT PMO team. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a dynamic global team in a company leveraging technology, data, digital solutions, and artificial intelligence to innovate, modernize, and create value across the organization. As a member of the Saputo PMO, you will be expected to lead through influence, bring teams together, and drive the successful delivery of strategic technology initiatives. You will plan, manage, and deliver a wide variety of high impact IT projects across our organization, with a focus on major AI use case delivery, SaaS implementations, digital platform deployments, process automation, data-driven solutions, and business transformation initiatives across our global divisions. Your ability to communicate with and collaborate IT and business stakeholders from all levels will be key to your success. As part of this role, you may be required to deliver other key strategic projects for the Organization outside of the Digital / AI specialization based on resource demands.

Your recipe for delivering successful projects in a dynamic and fast-paced environment includes being versatile and maintaining strong relationships with IT leaders, the business, and project core teams.

As a Project Manager, you will:

Define and lead the project approach from concept through execution, including translating ambiguous business objectives into a clear delivery strategy, work breakdown structure, staffing model, deliverables, and integrated project plan. You are responsible for establishing scope, estimates, schedule, costs, assumptions, and external dependencies in environments where requirements may initially be undefined or evolving.
Provide the Saputo IT Leadership Team with weekly progress reports including risks, issues, decisions as well as recommendations for adjustments as necessary. You will ensure the timely communication of relevant project information to all affected team members, including changes to the plans, team structure, commitments, and project dependencies.
Have strong leadership skills and provides guidance and support to optimize the performance of a diverse team, leads through influence indirect reports, and ensures that the project team follows all quality assurance processes, including periodic reviews and transitions.
Manage internal and external relationships and coordinates work between different teams globally.
Work effectively in a multi-site delivery model.
Lead the end‑to‑end management of third‑party vendors and system integrators, including participation in vendor selection, contract negotiation, commercial governance, and oversight of delivery performance throughout the full project lifecycle, ensuring alignment to scope, schedule, cost, and quality commitments.
Have a well-rounded Project Management knowledge base and the ability to quickly pickup and deliver projects across various applications and platforms.
You will also coach and support other IT resources assuming Project Lead roles, contribute to the development of PMO Processes, Tools and Methodology.

How you will make contributions that matter:

Reporting to the Portfolio Manager and working collaboratively with your stakeholders as well as the project, change management, and training teams, the Project Manager is responsible for:

Work Planning and Deliverable Management: You will adapt the PMO Work Planning processes and tools to the projects at hand and will maintain work plans, continuously monitoring actuals, and resolving/addressing cost and schedule variances. You will leverage the Deliverable Management process and tool to track the timely completion of all project Deliverables to the baselines.
Scope Management: You will operationalize the pre-defined PMO Scope Management Process to control the project scope and requirements. You will present scope changes meeting the pre-defined threshold to the Saputo IT leadership Committee for approval.
Performance and Reporting Management: You will leverage the pre-defined PMO processes, tools, and techniques to ensure timely and appropriate generation, and distribution of project progress and status information to project stakeholders.
Resource Management: You will be responsible for managing the resources of the project, including the capacity, defining the roles and responsibilities, creating a staffing plan, obtaining appropriate skilled resources, and managing shared capacity.
Issue/Risk Management/Quality: You will enforce the timely capture of project risks and issues by all team members, and will track, manage, resolve, or escalate project problems that impact the project's ability to meet the IT commitments as they pertain to schedule, resources, costs, quality.
Vendor and System Integrator Management: You will lead relationships with external vendors and system integrators, including defining statements of work, supporting contract negotiations, establishing delivery governance, managing financials and change controls, and ensuring vendor performance meets contractual and project expectations. You will proactively address delivery risks, dependencies, and integration challenges across internal and external teams.
Working with the IT PMO team to define and manage the required quality gates to perform quality planning, quality assurance, and quality control activities. You will be responsible for getting the Deliverable signoffs from the various stakeholders and ensuring that all expectations are met.
Contribute to the improvement of the PMO Tools and Processes, coach, and support IT resources in the development of their project management skills.

You are best suited for the role if you have the following qualifications:

Experience in manufacturing environments (Consumer Packaged Goods preferred) or related industry
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to motivate in a team-oriented, collaborative environment; ability to provide updates to Director and VP levels; adept at building relationships with internal teams and external partners
Experience reporting to and working with senior management and steering committees with stakeholders in IT and the Business
Strong Business Acumen
Experience managing Projects end to end from Initiation to Project Closure. This would include building Project Plans, Managing Resources, forecasting project budgets over $1M, tracking actuals, leading Steering Committees etc.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent work experience
Project Management certification or successful completion of a recognized project management curriculum (i.e. PMP, Prince II)
SCRUM Master certification or successful completion of projects in hybrid or agile environments (asset)
A minimum of 8 years of total IT project delivery experience, of which 3-5 years include leading full delivery lifecycle as well as managing a diverse team
Experience delivering large projects or programs with complex application delivery
Experience managing multiple system integrators
Experience managing a global Deployment is an asset
Experience delivering AI Use Case from Minimal Viable Product to full scale deployment (asset)
Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities under pressure
Ability to work independently and as part of a delivery team
Excellent interpersonal skills
Ability to coordinate 20+ shared resources and collaborate at all levels. Strong people management skills including delegation, motivation, coaching, and conflict management capabilities.
Ability to operate in complex, fast-paced project environment with interdependencies spanning multiple work-streams, teams, business divisions, geographies, time zones, & languages.
Experience managing packaged software and SaaS implementation methodologies. Cross functional exposure, including Manufacturing, Supply Chain and HR/Payroll an asset
Expert-level proficiency in MS Office (i.e. Word, PowerPoint, MS Project Professional and Excel) and SharePoint.
French/English bilingual competency is an asset
Product management knowledge or working experience is an asset.

We support and take care of our employees and their families by offering :

Generous and complete benefit coverage with group insurance
Group retirement plan with employer contribution
Telemedicine and assistance program for employees and their families
Employee Share Ownership Plan with an employer match
Paid Parental Leave program
Paid time off: Sick days, floater days and volunteer day off
Opportunity to contribute to a collective RRSP & TFSA
Training and development programs
Saputo Flex Program, flexible work environment (schedule/location/time off) according to department needs
Organized activities for employees and their families  
Advantageous discounts on Saputo products

Salary: 92,795$ to 121,795$

Salary offers will vary commensurate with experience, education, skills, and training.

Provide project status updates consistently to various stakeholders

Budget Focus Only - Supporting the Research & Development project budget processes and department-wide initiatives and training

Proven ability to solve problems creatively
Strong familiarity with project management software tools, methodologies, and best practices
Excellent analytical skills
Proven ability to complete projects according to outlined scope, budget, and timeline
Ability to delegate effectively
Proven leadership skills
Cost and risk management skills

: This role’s range is $60,750 - $99,750. Position Title: Program Manager, Platform Strategy & Launch Enablement

Work Location: East Hanover, NJ 07936

Assignment Duration: [Paste Duration]

Work Arrangement: Hybrid (2-3 days onsite and 2 days remote)

Position Summary
:
Seeking a Program Manager, Platform Strategy & Launch Enablement to coordinate the technology and data initiatives required to support a select portfolio of high-priority commercial product launches.
This role will serve as a key integrator across business, product, technology, CRM, data, analytics, and platform teams to help ensure launch-critical capabilities are delivered in alignment with business timelines and strategic objectives.

Background & Context:
In addition to traditional program management responsibilities, this role will provide platform strategy support by connecting related development efforts across teams, identifying dependencies and opportunities for alignment, and helping ensure investments contribute to a cohesive and scalable commercial technology ecosystem.
The successful candidate will not be responsible for defining business requirements, owning individual product roadmaps, or managing delivery teams. Instead, the role focuses on bringing together the various technology and data efforts required to support successful brand launches while providing leadership with visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and readiness.

Key Responsibilities:

Program Management & Delivery Coordination
Lead program management activities across technology and data initiatives supporting designated launch brands.
Maintain integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and key decisions across participating teams.
Coordinate activities across CRM, data, analytics, reporting, and platform workstreams.
Monitor progress against delivery commitments and proactively identify risks to launch timelines.
Facilitate cross-functional planning, status reviews, and readiness discussions.
Platform Strategy & Integration
Develop a comprehensive view of technology and data investments supporting launch objectives.
Connect initiatives across platforms and teams to identify dependencies, overlaps, gaps, and opportunities for synergy.
Help ensure launch-related capabilities align with broader platform strategies and technology roadmaps.
Promote reuse, scalability, and consistency across technology and data solutions whenever possible.
Partner with business and technology leaders to support informed investment and prioritization decisions.
Launch Enablement & Readiness
Track delivery of launch-critical technology and data capabilities.
Coordinate readiness activities across participating teams.
Maintain visibility into capability readiness, deployment plans, and key launch milestones.
Identify and escalate issues that may impact launch support capabilities.
Help ensure technology and data teams are aligned around launch objectives and critical delivery dates.
Governance & Executive Communications
Prepare executive dashboards, status reports, presentations, and leadership updates.
Consolidate workstream updates into a single integrated view of progress and readiness.
Facilitate governance forums and leadership reviews.
Maintain visibility into risks, decisions, dependencies, and action items.
Translate complex technical and operational information into concise business-focused communications.

Qualification & Experience:

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree required.
5+ years of experience in program management, PMO, business operations, platform operations, or related roles.
Experience coordinating complex technology and data initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to manage integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, and risks.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
Proven ability to influence and drive alignment in a matrixed environment.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or life sciences organizations.
Experience supporting commercial technology platforms, CRM ecosystems, customer engagement solutions, data platforms, or analytics capabilities.
Experience supporting product launches, launch readiness activities, or launch enablement programs.
Familiarity with CRM, customer data, reporting, analytics, omnichannel engagement, and commercial operations capabilities.
Experience working within Agile or Product Operating Model environments.

Additional Information:

What Success Looks Like
Technology and data capabilities required for priority launches are delivered on time and aligned to business needs.
Dependencies and risks are identified early and managed proactively.
Leadership has clear visibility into program status, readiness, and key decisions.
Technology and data investments are coordinated across teams rather than managed in isolation.
Launch teams are supported by scalable, reusable capabilities that strengthen the commercial platform ecosystem.
Critical launches are enabled by well-coordinated technology and data solutions that are ready when the business needs them.

Description

Penn Medicine is dedicated to our tripartite mission of providing the highest level of care to patients, conducting innovative research, and educating future leaders in the field of medicine. Working for this leading academic medical center means collaboration with top clinical, technical and business professionals across all disciplines.

Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Are you living your life's work?

Schedule:
Monday – Friday (8:00am – 4:30pm)

Summary:

The Senior Project Manager is pivotal in driving operational, financial and business development initiatives for key departments and services at Penn Medicine Princeton Health (PMPH). This role partners with executives, finance leadership, and department leaders to ensure optimal performance through strategic planning, data-driven decision-making, and the execution of complex operational and performance improvement projects and activities.

Ideal Attributes:

Leadership presence and credibility. Comfortable interacting directly with the CEO, CFO, senior executives, physicians, and department leaders. Communicate confidently without overstepping and can hold their own in senior-level discussions.
Exceptional judgment and discretion. Understands what is important, what is sensitive, what needs escalation, and what can be handled independently.
Strategic thinker who can execute. Can take an undefined and broad executive priority and turn it into a structured plan with milestones, owners, measures, and deliverables.
Highly analytical and data driven. Can synthesize operational, financial, market, and performance data and explain what it means, why it matters, and what should happen next.
Strong business and financial acumen. Understands budgets, profitability, growth opportunities, operational performance, and the business side of healthcare
Comfortable with ambiguity. Can create structure where there isn’t any.
Proactive and anticipatory. Thinks two or three steps ahead. Identifies risks, dependencies, stakeholder concerns, and potential barriers before the executive team will ask.
Influence without authority. The position needs to get senior leaders and cross-functional teams moving toward a common objective even when those individuals don’t report to them.
Strong relationship builder with high emotional intelligence. Able to read the room, adapt communication to different work styles, navigate disagreement, and develop credibility across clinical, operational, financial, and administrative groups.

Responsibilities:

Leads complex, high-impact, cross-functional initiatives that advance Penn Medicine Princeton Health’s strategic, operational, and financial priorities, translating organizational goals into executable plans with measurable outcomes.
Partners directly with executives, finance leadership, and department leaders to support strategic and business planning efforts, including the use of market data, financial analysis, and performance metrics to assess service-line performance, growth opportunities, and program profitability.
Provides advanced data analysis and strategic insights to inform executive decision-making, synthesizing information from multiple sources into clear recommendations that influence hospital- and system-level priorities.
Oversees the end-to-end execution of multi-department projects, ensuring alignment of scope, timelines, resources, and deliverables while proactively managing risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.
Develops and implements strategies to achieve financial and operational objectives by identifying trends, gaps, and opportunities for sustainable process improvement and performance optimization
Analyzes, interprets, and communicates complex operational, financial, and performance data, translating technical information into concise, actionable insights tailored to senior leadership and diverse stakeholder audiences.
Builds and maintains strong partnerships across clinical, operational, and administrative teams, fostering collaboration, alignment, and shared accountability in support of entity and system initiatives.
Influences decision-making at the senior leadership level through credibility, leadership presence, and evidence-based recommendations, serving as a trusted advisor on complex initiatives.
Provides mentorship, coaching, and guidance to project analysts and project managers, strengthening project management capabilities, analytical rigor, and performance excellence across the organization.
Performs duties in accordance with Penn Medicine and entity values, policies, and procedures
Other duties as assigned to support the unit, department, entity, and health system organization

Education or Equivalent Experience:

Bachelor of Arts or Science (Required)
Bachelors degree in Business administration or a Healthcare-related field 5+ years experience in Business Administration or a Healthcare-related field
Master of Arts or Science
Masters degree in Business administration or a Healthcare-related field 3+ years experience in Business Administration or a Healthcare-related field

About The Agency

Chartered in 1834, the Long Island Rail Road (LIRR) is the largest, busiest, and oldest continuously operating commuter railroad in the United States. In 2024, this 24/7/365 operation served 75.5 million riders on a system that stretches nearly 120 miles – from Penn Station and Grand Central Madison in Manhattan to Montauk on the eastern tip of Long Island.

Job Summary

Assist the PM in managing and coordinating activities of design and construction consultants, construction contractors, developers to ensure they meet established schedules and budget criteria. This position will provide direct support to Project Managers and their respective Directors upon assignment, in the Special Projects/ESA Department. Provide LIRR Project Management support, coordination, and direction to 3rd party contractors. Monitor progress throughout the project including the design, implementation, and commissioning phases. Assist in managing and coordinating activities of various Railroad Departments, and outside agencies to ensure that necessary approvals are obtained to implement capital projects and to assure that necessary reviews, inspections, testing, and commissioning are performed. Duties include preparing reports, presentations, research, and studies; managing the preparation of schedules estimates and project controls; reviewing and recommending approval of invoices, contract changes and consultant proposals; ensuring a safe working environment and adherence to guidelines of company safety policies and procedures.

Duties And Responsibilities

Provide support to the PM and Senior PM in managing the work of consultants, contractors, LIRR/Amtrak Force Account and private developers to ensure that established schedule and budget criteria are met.
Assist the PM in managing and coordinating activities of various Railroad departments, other MTA agencies, Amtrak and outside stakeholders. To ensure that necessary approvals are obtained, work inspections are performed, and contract/safety guidelines are followed.
Prepare reports, presentations, research and studies, run project meetings, prepare minutes, coordinate in-house and 3rd party interfaces, review and approve transmittals and various budget and administration reports.To advise management of job progress. To assure that all project control procedures are followed.
Prepare scopes and supervise the preparation of schedules and estimates. Review the validity of the cost and schedule impact associated with contract changes and participate in all change order negotiations. To ensure finished product meets Railroad’s standards and satisfies user department’s needs. To assure the most cost effective and usable product.
Assist in coordinating and integrating Operations, Engineering, 3rd party Contractors and other departments to support testing and commissioning. Assist in managing and coordinating all testing and commissioning activities for the projects and all 3rd party documents and transmittals.
Perform other assignments as requested by Senior Management.
Provide timely, accurate information as needed upon special request.
Ensure a safe working environment and adherence to guidelines of company safety policies and procedures. Lead by example to reduce number of employee and customer accidents.
Select, develop, and motivate personnel within the department. Provide career development for subordinates. Provide prompt and effective coaching and counseling. Promote safe work practices and provide safe working conditions. Create a professional environment that respects individual differences.
Promote positive, professional employee relations. Ensure Company principals, policies and procedures are consistently practiced and ensure the integrity of department standards. Ensure staff is knowledgeable and well informed on policies, procedures, state/federal laws and regulations.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Prior construction/engineering/manufacturing/project management experience.
Must have related project management experience preferably in an operation, transportation, engineering or manufacturing environment/industry.
Knowledge of the construction industry (building, bridges, railroad facilities, civil, electrical, mechanical trades, signal, communications and power).
Strong working knowledge of project scheduling and estimating for construction trades (all disciplines).
Proficient computer application skills (Windows Environment-Microsoft Office).
Business administration skills (i.e., report writing and spreadsheets).

The Fund Mandates team is responsible for the fund operations for the Schroder funds in the North America. It has oversight of third-party administrators for fund accounting, financial reporting, custody, transfer agency and expense payments. It assists internal teams and service providers with valuation, client reporting, tax reporting and product development.

This role will have fund operational oversight of complex private credit, collective trust and limited partnership funds. It includes oversight of third-party administrators and monitoring of deliverables and key performance indicators.

The Fund Mandates team sits under Platform Services within the Global Operating Platform at Schroders. The Global Operating Platform is made up of strategic core operational functions that work together alongside regional hubs in the UK, New York, Singapore and India.

We’re a global investment manager. We help institutions, intermediaries and individuals around the world invest money to meet their goals, fulfil their ambitions, and prepare for the future.

Facilitate working sessions that align stakeholders on requirements, priorities, dependencies, and decisions
Identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce rework, and improve implementation outcomes

What You Bring

You combine strong P&C insurance knowledge with hands-on experience translating business needs into technology solutions.

5+ years of Business Analyst experience, including experience within Property & Casualty insurance
Strong understanding of P&C insurance processes, including policy administration, rating, and underwriting
Hands-on experience with policy administration platforms; Majesco experience is strongly preferred
Experience supporting insurance software implementations, system modernization, or transformation programs
Ability to translate complex business processes into clear functional and system requirements
Experience working in Agile delivery environments, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and tools such as JIRA
Experience supporting SIT and UAT and working closely with business and technical teams through implementation
Strong analytical, facilitation, communication, and documentation skills
Ability to manage competing priorities and drive requirements to resolution

Bonus Points

ISO and/or NCCI circulars, regulatory updates, or insurance product changes
Translating ISO/NCCI changes into business, functional, or system requirements
Majesco Policy implementations within commercial or personal lines P&C environments

What Success Looks Like

Success means giving delivery teams clear, actionable requirements before development begins. You will help reduce ambiguity and rework, surface issues earlier in the implementation lifecycle, and keep business and technical teams aligned on what needs to be delivered.

Your work will directly contribute to stronger implementation quality, more predictable delivery, and policy administration solutions that meet client business needs.

Why Join Us

This role gives you the opportunity to deepen your P&C and Majesco expertise while taking meaningful ownership of complex implementation work.

Work remotely within the United States
Contribute to enterprise P&C policy administration modernization programs
Take ownership of high-impact business analysis workstreams
Work directly with experienced insurance, technology, and implementation professionals

new_jobs.description:
About Bodwé Group Companies

Bodwé is the Professional Services Group of Mno-Bmadsen, the investment enterprise and a wholly owned instrumentality of the Pokagon Band of Potawatomi. We are architects, planners, consultants, designers, engineers, scientists, and federal contractors, committed to growing the economy and legacy of the Pokagon Band and supporting its more than 6,000 citizens. We provide value by integrating expertise across the natural and built environment lifecycle—from pre-development and planning to design, procurement, construction, and operations. By integrating expertise across architecture, engineering, construction, and facility management, we deliver holistic, end-to-end solutions that drive efficiency and deliver distinctive outcomes.

Disclosure

This is a federal contracting opportunity that we, the Company, are bidding on and has not been awarded. The availability of this position is contingent upon successful award of the contract.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Lead Project Manager

to serve as the designated site lead supporting construction and facility engineering projects at the James J. Rowley Training Center (JJRTC), the primary training facility for the United States Secret Service. This role serves as the primary on-site contact with the government and provides leadership, oversight, and management of complex construction projects across a 490-acre federal training campus.

The Lead Project Manager will be responsible for directing multidisciplinary construction efforts, managing project execution, overseeing contractor performance, and ensuring successful delivery of facility planning, design, renovation, and construction initiatives. This position requires a highly skilled professional capable of independently managing large-scale commercial and government construction projects while maintaining focus on quality, schedule, budget, safety, and risk management.

Accommodation Requests

We are committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, contact careers@bodwegroup.com.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

The following inexhaustive list of duties represents a sample of work routinely performed by this role:

Serve as the designated on-site lead and primary liaison to the COR.
Provide campus-level coordination across multiple construction and facility engineering projects.
Align project priorities, resolve cross-project conflicts, and ensure consistent execution standards.
Oversee integrated planning, scheduling, and coordination across multidisciplinary teams.
Monitor overall program performance across cost, schedule, quality, and risk.
Coordinate with Government stakeholders, contractors, architects, engineers, and facility personnel.
Ensure consistency in execution across design, construction, renovation, and repair efforts.
Support high-level reviews, planning discussions, and campus-wide infrastructure initiatives.
Provide consolidated reporting, briefings, and recommendations to Government leadership.
Ensure adherence to contract requirements and JJRTC operational priorities.

Education, Experience, And Technical Skills

Required Education, Experience, and Technical Skills

Four-year degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
PMP (Project Management Professional) certification or other recognized project management certification.
Minimum of ten (10) years of project management experience supporting federal government construction projects.
Demonstrated experience managing multiple stakeholders, subcontractors, and project teams.
Strong knowledge of construction management principles, project scheduling, budgeting, risk management, and contract administration.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to obtain and maintain required government security clearances.
Must have or be able to obtain and maintain a Real ID or Passport in order to undergo commercial airfare travel
Must have or be able to obtain and maintain a valid driver's license

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting federal agencies, Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Department of Defense (DoD), or other government facilities.
Knowledge of federal construction standards, contracting processes, and facility management practices.
Experience managing large campus environments, training facilities, or mission-critical infrastructure projects.

Working Environment

This position primarily operates in a professional office setting with standard office equipment and a quiet, climate-controlled environment. While in the office, there is no regular exposure to loud noise, hazardous materials, or heavy machinery.

This role also requires periodic travel to project sites, including locations undergoing renovation or active construction. During site visits, the employee may be exposed to non-temperature-controlled environments, construction noise, dust, and other typical conditions found on job sites. Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required during these visits, depending on site conditions. While on site visits, an individual in this role will be required to work atypical hours at the request of the client or role demands.

Physical Demands

Sitting/Standing:

This is not a sedentary role. This role requires the ability to be on your feet moving around a construction site for most of the day interacting with contractors, contractor representatives, and inspecting the construction work that is being performed.

Walking:

This role requires the ability to move about outside in various geographic and building terrains to access a construction site to provide quality assurance services.

Stooping/Kneeling/Crouching/Crawling:

new_jobs.description:
About Bodwé Group Companies

Bodwé is the Professional Services Group of Mno-Bmadsen, the investment enterprise and a wholly owned instrumentality of the Pokagon Band of Potawatomi. We are architects, planners, consultants, designers, engineers, scientists, and federal contractors, committed to growing the economy and legacy of the Pokagon Band and supporting its more than 6,000 citizens. We provide value by integrating expertise across the natural and built environment lifecycle—from pre-development and planning to design, procurement, construction, and operations. By integrating expertise across architecture, engineering, construction, and facility management, we deliver holistic, end-to-end solutions that drive efficiency and deliver distinctive outcomes.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Federal A/E Project Manager is responsible for the successful delivery of architectural, engineering, and facility projects for federal clients in the Washington, DC metropolitan area. This client-facing position serves as a primary day-to-day interface with federal clients and manages a portfolio of concurrent projects from initial assignment and scope definition through design, construction administration, and closeout.

The Project Manager is accountable for project scope, schedule, budget, staffing, quality, risk, and client expectations while leading multidisciplinary architectural and engineering teams and specialty consultants. Projects will vary in size, complexity, discipline, and stage of completion and may involve existing, occupied, secure, historic, and operationally sensitive facilities.

The successful candidate will combine strong A/E project-management capabilities with practical knowledge of design and construction, excellent client-service skills, and the ability to respond effectively to changing priorities. This role offers a hybrid work setup, combining remote work from home with regular, in‑person presence at client facilities throughout the Washington, DC metropolitan area. Candidates must reside within commuting distance to meet onsite requirements.

Accommodation Requests

We are committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, contact careers@bodwegroup.com.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

The following inexhaustive list of duties represents a sample of work routinely performed by this role:

Federal Client Relationship Management

Serve as a primary day-to-day point of contact for assigned federal clients, including Contracting Officer's Representatives (CORs), facility representatives, project stakeholders, and other Government personnel.

Project Leadership & Delivery Management

Maintain visibility across the assigned project portfolio, including project priorities, current phase, upcoming milestones, Government reviews, open decisions, risks, and staffing requirements.
Coordinate project initiation and confirm client requirements, available information, required disciplines, deliverables, design milestones, construction budgets, and schedule before significant design effort begins.
Identify and manage project risks affecting schedule, scope, budget, staffing, quality, and client operations.
Forecast near-term resource requirements and coordinate with discipline leaders to resolve potential staffing conflicts.
Maintain organized and accessible project records, correspondence, drawings, meeting minutes, schedules, action items, and decision logs.
Escalate material scope, schedule, staffing, contractual, or client issues to company leadership as appropriate.

Financial & Contract Management

Manage project financial performance, including budgets, labor utilization, earned revenue, forecasting, profitability, and remaining effort.
Monitor actual project effort against established budgets and staffing plans and identify potential overruns before they affect project performance.
Understand and manage projects performed under Firm-Fixed-Price and other federal contract structures.
Support development of project scopes, staffing plans, fee proposals, amendments, and additional-service requests.
Coordinate with company operations and finance personnel to maintain accurate project forecasts and financial reporting.
Understand contractual requirements and recognize conditions that may represent a change in scope or require Contracting Officer authorization.

A/E Design and Technical Delivery

Manage architectural and engineering projects through planning, investigation, design, construction documents, bidding/procurement support, construction administration, and closeout.
Coordinate multidisciplinary design teams and specialty consultants to produce complete, coordinated, and constructible project deliverables.
Review drawings, specifications, cost estimates, schedules, technical studies, and other project deliverables for completeness and alignment with client requirements.
Coordinate field investigations and verification of existing conditions in occupied facilities.
Facilitate resolution of interdisciplinary design issues and conflicts.
Understand the relationship between design decisions, construction cost, constructability, facility operations, schedule, and project risk.
Coordinate design reviews and ensure Government comments are documented, assigned, resolved, and backchecked.
Support projects involving renovation of existing, occupied, historic, and operationally sensitive facilities.

Quality Assurance, Compliance & Construction Administration

Ensure required quality-control reviews are completed and documented before project deliverables are submitted.
Coordinate discipline and interdisciplinary reviews of drawings, specifications, cost estimates, and other design documents.
Ensure projects comply with applicable federal requirements, building codes, accessibility requirements, life-safety requirements, client standards, and project-specific criteria.
Coordinate construction-phase services including RFIs, submittal reviews, site observations, progress meetings, field issue resolution, punch lists, and project closeout.
Maintain continuity between the design team and construction-phase activities.
Coordinate with Designers of Record and technical discipline leads regarding issues requiring professional judgment or design changes.

Team Leadership

Lead multidisciplinary project teams without requiring direct supervisory authority.
Establish clear responsibilities, schedules, deliverables, and expectations for internal team members and consultants.
Facilitate collaboration among clients, consultants, contractors, and internal project teams.
Mentor developing Project Managers and technical staff in project-delivery practices.
Promote accountability, responsiveness, quality, and client service across project teams.

Required Education, Experience, and Technical Skills

Bachelor's degree in architecture, engineering, construction management, or a related field.
7+ years of progressively responsible Federal A/E or construction project-management experience, including responsibility for project scope, schedule, budget, multidisciplinary coordination, and client communication.
Experience managing A/E or facility projects for federal government clients, including direct interaction with Government project managers, Contracting Officer's Representatives (CORs), or other federal stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience simultaneously managing a portfolio of A/E or facility projects at different stages of planning, design, construction, and clos
Experience managing projects involving renovation of existing and occupied buildings.
Strong understanding of architectural and engineering design processes, construction documents, specifications, cost estimating, and construction administration.
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary architects, engineers, specialty consultants, and contractors.
Strong client-facing communication, meeting facilitation, organization, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to regularly work from and travel to client facilities throughout the Washington, DC metropolitan area.
Ability to obtain and maintain any federal facility access, background investigation, or security credentials required for assigned projects.
Valid driver's license and ability to be considered insurable under the Company's insurance policy.

Acting as a connective layer across teams, the AVP brings structure and accountability to complex, cross-functional initiatives. The AVP will contribute to strategic planning and decision-making while primarily focusing on disciplined execution, cross-functional coordination, and operational follow-through.

Program and Project Execution

Manage and execute key initiatives across the global real estate portfolio, from initial planning through operational readiness and ongoing use.
Translate priorities and strategic decisions into actionable project plans with clear milestones, responsibilities, timelines, and supporting documentation.
Coordinate activity across site acquisition, design, construction, occupancy planning, operational transition, and post-opening integration, as applicable.
Maintain momentum across concurrent initiatives by tracking progress, identifying risks and dependencies, resolving roadblocks, and escalating issues when necessary.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Coordinate closely with Facilities, Security, Logistics, IT, Client Experience, Marketing, Events, Programming, Global Fine Arts, Luxury, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and other teams as required.
Serve as a central point of coordination, ensuring stakeholders understand project objectives, responsibilities, deadlines, and decisions.
Facilitate productive working sessions and maintain alignment among stakeholders with different priorities and areas of expertise.
Follow up consistently with project owners and contributors to ensure commitments are met, issues are addressed, and decisions are made in a timely manner.

Communication and Stakeholder Management

Establish clear and consistent communication so relevant stakeholders remain informed of project progress, decisions, risks, changes, and upcoming milestones.
Prepare concise project updates, presentations, briefing materials, and decision documents for senior leadership and working teams.
Synthesize complex or fragmented information into clear summaries, recommendations, decisions, and next steps.
Structure meeting agendas, document decisions, assign actions, ensure timely follow-through, and surface issues requiring leadership input with sufficient context.

Governance, Tracking and Reporting

Establish and maintain practical governance structures, project trackers, action logs, decision records, and reporting tools.
Monitor progress against milestones, budgets, dependencies, and operational-readiness requirements while maintaining clear accountability for owners, deadlines, and next actions.
Support a consistent operating cadence, including monthly management meetings, quarterly business reviews, budget planning sessions, and project-specific working groups.
Develop and track key performance indicators, identify gaps or recurring execution challenges, and recommend improvements to project processes and ways of working.

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve coordination, communication, documentation, and accountability across the function.
Develop repeatable tools, templates, and processes that strengthen project delivery and operational consistency.
Apply lessons learned from completed initiatives to improve future planning and execution.
Encourage collaborative problem-solving, practical innovation, and continuous improvement across project teams.
